blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to infer psychological attributes, predict individual behaviour, and simulate human populations. However, despite generating plausible responses, they often misrepresent individuals and distort population statistics. Here we introduce Chiron, a foundation model to measure and predict human behaviour. We jointly fine-tune an LLM to represent psychological constructs, predict individual behaviour, and align population response distributions with human statistics. The training and evaluation data span 36 behavioural domains and 78 social science experiments, comprising 288,307 person records, 1,411,750 atomic behavioural decisions, and 99,953 psychometric assessments over 109 psychological constructs. In our evaluations, Chiron's psychological measurements agree more closely with human self-reports and exhibit fewer biases that undermine psychometric validity. It predicts individual behaviour more accurately than frontier LLMs (up to 28.4% relative improvement). In simulations of social science experiments, it more accurately captures the direction and magnitude of human experimental effects (82.2--94.3% lower effect-size estimation error). Together, these results establish Chiron as a unified computational instrument for measuring and predicting human behaviour.
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLMS)越来越多地用于推断心理属性,预测个人行为,模拟人类人口. 然而,尽管作出了令人信服的反应,但它们往往歪曲个人,歪曲人口统计数据。 在这里,我们介绍Chiron,一个衡量和预测人类行为的基础模型. 我们共同调整了LLM,以体现心理构造,预测个人行为,并使人口反应分布与人类统计相一致。 培训和评估数据涉及36个行为领域和78个社会科学实验,包括288 307人的记录、1 411 750个原子行为决定和109个心理构造的99 953个心理测量评估。 在我们的评价中,奇伦的心理测量更接近于人类的自我报告,并表现出较少的偏见破坏心理测量的有效性. 它对个人行为的预测比边疆法学硕士(相对改善率高达28.4%)更为准确。 在社会科学实验的模拟中,它更准确地捕捉人类实验效果的方向和规模(82.2-94.3%)低效应大小估计误差. 这些结果共同确立了Chiron作为衡量和预测人类行为的统一计算工具.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: A central goal of psychology and the behavioural sciences is to understand how people differ and how these differences shape behaviour across situations [ Cronbach and Meehl, 1955 ] . Psychological measurement draws on what people say and do to infer latent attributes such as personality traits, values, and affective states, making subjective inner experience explicit and comparable across individuals [ Demszky et al., 2023 ] . Behavioural prediction uses the available evidence to anticipate how individuals and populations will respond in new situations. Together, measurement and prediction provide complementary foundations for modelling human behaviour, linking interpretable psychological constructs with empirical predictive power [ Hofman et al., 2021 ] .
blocks.zh: 心理学和行为科学的一个中心目标是了解人们的差别,以及这些差别如何塑造各种情况的行为[Cronbach and Meehl, 1955]. 心理测量借鉴了人们的言行来推断潜在的属性,如个性特征,价值,和情感状态,使主观的内在体验在个人之间变得明确和可比[Demszky等人,2023]. 行为预测利用现有证据来预测个人和人口将如何在新情况下作出反应。 共同的测量和预测为模拟人类行为提供了互补的基础,将可解释的心理构造与经验预测力联系起来[Hofman等人,2021].

blocks.en:
Recent work has begun to use large language models (LLMs) across these tasks, deploying them both as analytical instruments to infer psychological attributes from digital traces [ Peters and Matz, 2024 , Wright et al., 2026 , Ziems et al., 2024 ] and as simulated research subjects to predict behaviour and replicate surveys or experiments [ Argyle et al., 2023 , Aher et al., 2023 ] .
However, off-the-shelf LLMs often generate fluent, plausible responses that misrepresent individual differences and distort population statistics, raising several foundational challenges across psychology and computational social science.
(1) Unstructured psychological assessments suffer from systematic psychometric biases. When prompted to score psychological attributes from text, general-purpose LLMs inflate socially desirable traits, compress inter-individual score dispersion, and shift estimates under superficial changes in prompt framing [ Abdurahman et al., 2024 , Ye et al., 2025b , Brickman et al., 2025 ] .
(2) Psychological construct interpretability is disconnected from individual behavioural prediction. Existing approaches either extract trait scores without verifying out-of-sample predictive power [ Zhu et al., 2025 ] or fine-tune black-box predictors without grounding representations in interpretable constructs [ Binz et al., 2025 , Xie et al., 2025 ] . Moreover, unadapted LLMs struggle to infer individuals’ distinctive values from their statements [ Jiang et al., 2025 ] , flatten within-group diversity into demographic stereotypes [ Wang et al., 2025 ] , and compress the linguistic diversity that reflects different individual traits [ Sourati et al., 2026 ] .
(3) Simulated populations exhibit homogenization and variance collapse. At the population level, LLM-based simulations cluster around stereotypical or modal responses [ Kozlowski and Evans, 2025 ] . While simulated cohorts often recover the qualitative direction of experimental treatments, they systematically underestimate within-condition human variance. Consequently, these simulations severely exaggerate standardized effect magnitudes [ Ashokkumar et al., 2026 ] , often yield false positives on null findings [ Cui et al., 2025 ] , and only weakly capture cross-national variations in human preferences [ Chen et al., 2026 ] .
(4) Privacy and data-access constraints limit individual-level calibration. Adapting models to overcome these distortions requires rich behavioural supervision. However, raw human records paired with comprehensive psychometric annotations or participant-level experimental responses are rarely accessible at scale due to privacy and institutional constraints [ Xu et al., 2026 ] .
blocks.zh:
最近的工作已经开始在这些任务中使用大型语言模型(LLMs),把它们作为分析工具,从数字痕迹中推断心理属性[Peters and Matz, 2024, Wright et al., 2026, Ziems et al., 2024] ,并作为模拟研究课题来预测行为和复制调查或实验[. Argyle等人,2023年 ,Aher等人,2023年] (中文(简体) ).
然而,现成的LLMS往往产生流利的、可信的反应,歪曲个人差异和扭曲人口统计,在心理学和计算社会科学中引起若干基本挑战。
(1) 无结构的心理评估有系统性的心理计量偏差。 在促使人们从文字中获得心理属性时,一般用途的LLMs会放大社会上可取的特征,压缩个人之间的得分分散,并在迅速设定的表面变化下进行转移估计[Abdurahman等人,2024年;Ye等人,2025年b;Brickman等人,2025年]。
(2)心理构造可解释性与个人行为预测脱节. 现有方法或者在没有核实外抽样预测力的情况下提取特征分数[Zhu等人,2025年],或者微调黑箱预测器,而不在可解释构造中打下基础[。 Binz等人,2025年,谢等人,2025年]. 此外,未经调整的LLMS还努力从他们的陈述中推断个人的独特价值[。 Jiang et al., 2025],将群体内的多样性平整成人口定型[Wang et al., 2025],并压缩反映不同个体特征的语言多样性[Sourati et al., 2026].
(3) 模拟人口呈现同质化和差异崩溃。 在人口层面,基于LLM的模拟围绕定型或模式反应组合[Kozlowski和Evans,2025]. 虽然模拟组群经常恢复实验治疗的质量方向,但它们系统地低估了条件内人类差异. 因此,这些模拟大大夸大了标准化效应的大小[Ashokkumar等人,2026年],往往对无效结果产生虚假的阳性[Cui等人,2025年],而只是弱化地捕捉到人类偏好方面的跨国变化[. 陈等,2026].
(4) 隐私和数据存取限制限制了个人一级的校准。 调整模型以克服这些扭曲现象需要丰富的行为监督。 然而,由于隐私和体制制约,配有综合心理计量说明或参与者级实验反应的原始人类记录很少能够大规模获取[徐等人,2026].

blocks.en: These failures stem from a fundamental mismatch between the training objectives of general-purpose LLMs and the methodological requirements of behavioural science. Standard instruction tuning and preference optimization reward responses judged helpful, normative, or socially desirable by annotators, but do not require models to anchor internal representations in psychometric constructs, preserve idiosyncratic individual differences, or calibrate output distributions to human population variance. Aggregating feedback across annotators further privileges modal preferences at the expense of minority and individual perspectives [ Santurkar et al., 2023 , Sorensen et al., 2024 , Conitzer et al., 2024 ] . Consistent with this mechanism, reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) reduces output entropy [ Kirk et al., 2024 ] and collapses conceptual diversity in simulated populations [ Murthy et al., 2025 ] . Addressing the challenges above therefore requires moving beyond zero-shot prompting of conversational chatbots toward a foundation model explicitly architected and trained for psychometric validity, individual predictive fidelity, and distributional alignment.
blocks.zh: 这些失败是由于通用法学硕士的培训目标与行为科学的方法要求之间的根本不匹配。 标准指令调整和优化偏好奖励反应被注解者判断为有帮助的,规范的,或社会上可取的,但并不要求模型将内部表现定位在心理测量构造中,保存特异性个体差异,或将产出分布校准为人类人口差异. 以牺牲少数群体和个人观点为代价,进一步汇总各注释者的反馈[Santurkar等人,2023年;Sorensen等人,2024年;Conitzer等人,2024年]。 与这种机制相一致的是,从人类反馈中强化学习(RLHF)会减少输出py[Kirk等人,2024年],并在模拟人群中崩溃概念多样性[. Murthy et al., 2025] (英语). 因此,要应对上述挑战,就必须超越零射线,促使对话聊天员转向一个基础模型,该模型明确设计并经过了心理计量有效性、个人预测忠诚度和分布一致性方面的培训。

blocks.en:
Here we introduce Chiron, a foundation model to measure and predict human behaviour ( Figs. 1 and 2 ). Chiron jointly learns psychological measurement, individual behavioural prediction, and population alignment within a shared language model through three mechanisms.
(1) A decoupled latent readout estimates psychological constructs directly from person representations. Chiron attaches a centred cosine measurement head to the hidden state at the end of a person’s observed records, scoring 109 psychological constructs without verbalized text generation and avoiding generative biases.
(2) Joint psychometric supervision anchors individual behavioural prediction in latent construct representations. Measurement supervision across the 109 constructs directly shapes the shared person representation. The model then predicts individual behaviour from this structured psychological representation, linking interpretable traits with accurate behavioural prediction.
(3) Constrained population synthesis calibrates the model’s response distribution to human experimental statistics. Because participant-level experimental data are rarely public, we synthesize virtual respondent cohorts whose answers match published condition means, standard deviations, and treatment effects. By training the model to generate diverse cohort responses for each experimental condition, Chiron counteracts variance collapse and reproduces human response distributions.
blocks.zh:
在这里我们介绍Chiron,一个用来衡量和预测人类行为的基础模型(图1和图2). Chiron通过三种机制,在一个共同的语言模型内共同学习心理测量,个人行为预测,以及人口协调.
(1) 与个人表述直接相关的潜在读取估计心理构造。 Chiron将一个中枢的余弦测量头附在一个人所观察到的记录的末端的隐藏状态上,评分109个心理构造,没有口头化的文字生成,并避免基因偏差.
(2) 联合心理计量监督将个人行为预测植根于潜在构造表达。 跨越109个结构的计量监督直接塑造了共享人的代表。 该模型然后从这种结构化的心理表现来预测个人行为,将可解释的特征与准确的行为预测联系起来.
(3)限制人口合成,校准模型对人类实验统计的反应分布. 由于参与者层面的实验数据很少公开,我们合成了虚拟的应答组群,这些组群的答案与公布的条件表示,标准偏差,和治疗效果相匹配. 通过对模型进行培训,为每个实验条件生成不同的群反应,Chiron抵消了差异崩溃并复制了人类反应分布.

blocks.en: We train Chiron on a heterogeneous collection of questionnaire responses, personal writing, online posts, and experimental data. The combined training and evaluation data span 36 behavioural and psychological assessment domains and 78 social science experiments, comprising 288,307 person records, 1,411,750 atomic behavioural decisions and 99,953 psychological scores spanning 109 psychological constructs. To overcome privacy and data-access barriers where raw human records or comprehensive annotations are unavailable, our training framework combines direct supervision from human records and psychometric assessments, self-supervised masked observation prediction on unlabelled personal writing, and calibrated synthetic supervision derived from psychometric item pools and published aggregate human statistics.
blocks.zh: 我们训练Chiron 收集各种各样的问卷答复、个人写作、在线帖子和实验数据。 综合培训和评估数据涉及36个行为和心理评估领域和78个社会科学实验,包括288 307人记录、1 411 750个原子行为决定和99 953个心理分数,涉及109个心理构造。 为了克服没有原始人类记录或全面说明的隐私和数据获取障碍,我们的培训框架将直接监督人类记录和心理计量评估、对无标签的个人书写进行自我监督的蒙面观察预测、以及根据心理计量项目集合和公布的人类综合统计数据进行校准的合成监督结合起来。

blocks.en:
We evaluate Chiron across psychological measurement, individual behavioural prediction, and population simulation.
Its psychological measurements agree more closely with human self-reports across five datasets spanning nine constructs (mean Pearson r = 0.390 r=0.390 , compared with 0.320 0.320 – 0.353 0.353 for frontier LLMs), while recovering empirical inter-construct correlations reported in the psychometric literature ( r = 0.806 r=0.806 – 0.819 0.819 across 150 construct pairs).
Compared with frontier LLMs, Chiron substantially mitigates measurement biases (including score compression, irrelevant-context sensitivity, and evidence-order sensitivity), and responds monotonically to experimental manipulations of construct-relevant evidence across all 109 constructs.
For individual prediction, Chiron predicts individual behaviour more accurately than frontier LLMs across 29 behavioural domains (mean prediction accuracy of 0.504 0.504 versus 0.393 0.393 – 0.418 0.418 , up to 28.4% relative improvement), generalizing both to unseen individuals and to held-out domains excluded from prediction training.
For population simulations across 15 held-out experimental studies, Chiron preserves realistic within-condition dispersion and reproduces human experimental effects with 90.5% direction agreement and 82.2–94.3% lower effect-size estimation error (Cohen’s d d MAE of 0.224 0.224 versus 1.254 1.254 – 3.895 3.895 for frontier LLMs).
Together, these findings establish Chiron as a unified computational instrument for measuring psychological attributes and predicting human behaviour at individual and population scales.

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Overview of Chiron. A single language model is jointly trained across three objectives: (1) psychological measurement , where construct scores supervise a measurement head to estimate psychological attributes from personal records; (2) individual behavioural prediction , where answers withheld from a person’s records supervise the prediction of unseen responses and choices; and (3) population simulation , where virtual respondents synthesized to match published human statistics supervise the generation of population-level response distributions.
blocks.zh: 图2:Chiron概况. 一个单一语言模型在三个目标上得到联合培训:(1) 心理测量,其中构造分数监督一个测量头,以估计个人记录的心理属性;(2) 个人行为预测,其中从个人记录中扣下的答复监督对看不见的反应和选择的预测;(3) 人口模拟,其中虚拟应答者合成,以配合已公布的人类统计数据,监督人口层面反应分布的产生。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Large language models are reshaping psychology and computational social science across multiple research roles, most notably as analytical assistants that extract psychological constructs from unstructured digital traces and as simulated research subjects that model individual decisions and collective experimental outcomes [ Demszky et al., 2023 , Ziems et al., 2024 , Xu et al., 2026 ] . Below, we situate Chiron within prior work on psychological measurement, individual behavioural prediction, and population simulation, highlighting how our unified training framework addresses recurring validity and fidelity challenges across these areas.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型正在重塑跨越多个研究角色的心理学和计算社会科学,最显著的是作为分析助手从无结构的数字痕迹中提取心理构造,以及模拟研究课题,模拟个人决定和集体实验结果[Demszky等人,2023年,Ziems等人,2024年,徐等人,2026年]. 下面,我们把Chiron放在以前关于心理测量、个人行为预测和人口模拟的工作之中,强调我们统一的培训框架如何解决这些领域反复出现的有效性和忠诚性挑战。

blocks.en:
Psychological measurement relates observable behavioural or linguistic evidence to latent constructs such as personality traits, values, and affective states [ Cronbach and Meehl, 1955 ] . Moving beyond traditional self-report questionnaires and closed-vocabulary lexicon tools, recent studies prompt or adapt LLMs to infer dispositions from social-media posts, essays, and clinical narratives [ Peters and Matz, 2024 , Wright et al., 2026 ] .
However, psychometric evaluations reveal substantial validity limitations in off-the-shelf LLMs: inferred scores often show modest agreement with self-reports [ Zhu et al., 2025 ] , exhibit systematic positivity and Western-centric biases [ Abdurahman et al., 2024 , Xu et al., 2026 ] , compress inter-individual variance [ Ye et al., 2025b ] , and shift under superficial changes in prompt wording, surrounding context, or evidence ordering [ Brickman et al., 2025 , Ye et al., 2025a ] .
Whereas general LLMs rely on autoregressive text generation to verbalize numerical ratings, Chiron introduces a dedicated centred cosine readout head trained on multi-source psychometric supervision across 109 constructs, decoupling construct measurement from generative reporting biases.
blocks.zh:
心理测量将可观察到的行为或语言证据与人格特征、价值和情感状态等潜在构造联系起来[Cronbach和Meehl,1955年]。 最近的研究超越了传统的自我报告问卷和封闭的省词典工具,促使或调整了LLMs来推断社会媒体文章、散文和临床叙事的处置[Peters and Matz, 2024, Wright等人, 2026].
然而,心理计量评价揭示了现成的有限责任公司的实质性有效性限制:推断得分往往显示对自报[Zhu等人,2025年]不太同意,显示出系统性的正向性和以西方为中心的偏见[Abdurahman等人,2024年,Xu等人,2026年],压缩个人之间的差异[Ye等人,2025年b],在表面变化下迅速改变措辞、周围环境或命令的证据[Brickman等人,2025年,Ye等人,2025年a]。
一般的LLMS依靠自递式文本生成来口头表示数字评级,而Chiron则引入了在109个构件中经过多源心理计量监督培训的专用的中环余弦读取头,将构造计量与基因报告偏差脱钩。

blocks.en:
A growing literature seeks to predict how specific individuals will think, choose, or act across situations, which is a prerequisite for reconciling explanatory psychological constructs with out-of-sample predictability [ Hofman et al., 2021 , Xu et al., 2026 ] . One approach supplies a general-purpose LLM with personal context in the prompt: generative agents condition behaviour on memory streams [ Park et al., 2023 ] , and interview-grounded agents use qualitative transcripts to emulate specific individuals [ Park et al., 2024 ] .
While rich personal context improves simulation plausibility, unadapted LLMs still struggle to infer an individual’s underlying values and preferences from their own statements [ Jiang et al., 2025 ] and often fall back on demographic or persona stereotypes [ Wang et al., 2025 , Xu et al., 2026 ] .
A complementary line of work fine-tunes foundation models directly on behavioural data: Centaur learns from trial-by-trial choices across cognitive psychology experiments [ Binz et al., 2025 ] , and Be.FM integrates experimental, survey, and literature data for behavioural prediction [ Xie et al., 2025 ] . Chiron advances this paradigm in three ways: it generalizes prediction across heterogeneous personal records (combining questionnaires, essays, and social-media traces), introduces self-supervised masked observation prediction to leverage unlabelled personal writing at scale, and jointly supervises psychological measurement and behavioural prediction within a shared representation space so that latent construct structure informs individual choice prediction.
blocks.zh:
越来越多的文献试图预测具体个人将如何思考,选择,或如何在各种情况下采取行动,这是调和解释性心理结构与外证可预测性的先决条件[Hofman等人,2021年,徐等人,2026年]. 一种方法是提供具有个人背景的通用LLM:基因剂在记忆流上规定行为条件[Park等人,2023年],而基于访谈的代理人使用定性记录片来模仿特定个人[Park等人,2024年].
虽然丰富的个人背景改善了模拟的合理性,但未经调整的法学硕士仍然难以从个人的言论中推断个人的基本价值和偏好[。] Jiang et al., 2025]),并经常回到人口或人的陈规定型观念[. Wang et al., 2025., 徐等人, 2026] (中文(中国大陆) ).
一项补充性的工作是对直接基于行为数据的基础模型进行微调: Centaur从认知心理学实验的逐项选择中学习[Binz等人,2025年],Be.FM将实验,调查,文献数据整合到行为预测中[Xie等人,2025年]. Chiron从三个方面推进了这一范式:它概括了不同个人记录的预测(组合问卷,散文,以及社交媒体的痕迹),引入了自我监督的蒙面观测预测,以利用规模上无标签的个人写作,并在共享的表示空间内联合监督心理测量和行为预测,使潜构结构为个人选择预测提供参考.

blocks.en:
LLMs are also widely used as in silico research subjects to simulate survey populations [ Argyle et al., 2023 ] , replicate human-subject experiments [ Aher et al., 2023 , Cui et al., 2025 , Ashokkumar et al., 2026 ] , and probe strategic or social interactions [ Akata et al., 2025 , Kozlowski and Evans, 2025 , Xu et al., 2026 ] . Despite their promise for pretesting experimental designs and exploring counterfactual scenarios, empirical audits consistently show that off-the-shelf LLMs suffer from variance compression and hyper-accuracy distortion [ Kozlowski and Evans, 2025 , Xu et al., 2026 ] : simulated samples suppress within-group heterogeneity [ Santurkar et al., 2023 , Wang et al., 2025 ] , inflate standardized treatment effect sizes, produce false positives on null findings [ Cui et al., 2025 , Ashokkumar et al., 2026 ] , and poorly reflect cross-national preference distributions [ Chen et al., 2026 ] .
Turning LLM simulations into reliable scientific instruments requires empirical calibration against observed human distributions, yet individual-level human responses are frequently unavailable due to privacy and institutional constraint [ Xu et al., 2026 ] . Chiron addresses this bottleneck through constrained population synthesis , reconstructing respondent-level supervision from published aggregate human statistics so that the model’s conditional output distribution is directly aligned with empirical human means, variances, and treatment effects.
blocks.zh:
此外,LLMs还被广泛用于硅化研究课题,以模拟调查人口[Argyle等人,2023年],复制人类主体实验[Aher等人,2023年,Cui等人,2025年,Ashokkumar等人,2026年],并探索战略或社会互动[Akata等人,2025年,Kozlowski和Evans,2025年,Xu等人,2026年]。 尽管经验性审计承诺对实验设计进行预先测试并探索反事实假想,但经验性审计始终表明,现成的LLMs存在差异压缩和超准确性扭曲[Kozlowski and Evans, 2025, Xu等人, 2026]]:模拟样本抑制组内异质性[Santurkar等人, 2023, Wang等人, 2025] , 放大标准化处理效果的大小, 对无效结论产生虚假的阳性[Cui等人, 2025, Ashokkumar等人, 2026], 并且不能很好地反映跨国偏好分布[Chen等人, 2026].
将LLM模拟转化为可靠的科学仪器需要根据观测到的人类分布进行实证校准,然而由于隐私和体制约束,个人层面的人类反应却经常得不到[Xu等人,2026]. Chiron通过限制人口合成来解决这个瓶颈,从公布的人类综合统计数据中重建应答层面的监督,使模型的有条件产出分布与人类经验手段、差异和处理效果直接一致。

blocks.en: 3 Methods
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: To address the methodological challenges of using language models in behavioural science (e.g., construct invalidity, loss of individual heterogeneity, and population variance collapse), Chiron unifies psychological measurement, individual behavioural prediction, and population simulation within a single foundation model ( Fig. 2 ). We first describe the multi-source data corpus and task formulations ( § 3.1 ), then detail the model architecture ( § 3.2 ) and joint training framework ( § 3.3 ), and finally discuss the mechanistic and methodological advantages of Chiron over both general-purpose LLMs and traditional psychological instruments ( § 3.4 ).
blocks.zh: 应对在行为科学中使用语言模型的方法挑战(例如,构造无效性、个人异质性丧失和人口差异崩溃),Chiron统一心理测量、个人行为预测和单一基础模型内的人口模拟(图2)。 我们首先描述了多源数据库和任务表述(第3.1节),然后详细介绍了模型架构(第3.2节)和联合培训框架(第3.3节),最后讨论了Chiron相对于通用的LLM和传统心理仪器(第3.4节)的机械和方法优势。

blocks.en: 3.1 Data corpus and task formulation
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 数据集和任务拟订

blocks.en: Human psychology and behaviour manifest across diverse empirical records: free-form personal writing, standardized psychometric inventories, everyday behavioural choices, and controlled experimental manipulations. We curate a unified training and evaluation corpus spanning 36 behavioural and psychological assessment domains (109 psychological constructs) and 78 scenario-based social science experiments, totalling 288,307 person records, 1,411,750 atomic behavioural decisions, and 99,953 psychometric assessments. As summarized with representative examples in Table 1 (full dataset-by-dataset inventory in Table 2 ), the corpus is organized around three complementary tasks.

blocks.en: 3.2 Model architecture
blocks.zh: 3.2 示范结构

blocks.en: Chiron combines a shared causal language model backbone with a dedicated psychometric measurement head ( Fig. 2 ). For individual-level tasks, the model takes a person’s records as input, enclosed within <person_records> … </person_records> . The measurement head reads continuous construct scores directly from the resulting person representation, and the language model generates answers to subsequent prediction questions about that person. For population simulation, the language model takes an experimental scenario and its outcome questions as input and generates respondent-level answers via repeated sampling.
blocks.zh: Chiron将共享的因果语言模型骨干与专用的心理计量头(图2 )结合. 对于个人一级的任务,模型将一个人的记录作为输入,附于 < person_records > ... < person_records > 。 测量头直接从产生的人物表示中读取连续构造分数,语言模型生成对随后有关该人物的预测问题的答案. 对于人口模拟,语言模型将实验情景及其结果问题作为投入,并通过重复抽样生成答卷人层面的答案.

blocks.en: Let ℛ p = { r 1 , … , r n } \mathcal{R}_{p}=\{r_{1},\ldots,r_{n}\} denote the records available for person p p , which may consist of questionnaire item–response pairs, free-form personal writing, social-media posts, or recorded behavioural choices. We extract the person representation, h p ∈ ℝ d h_{p}\in\mathbb{R}^{d} , from the final-layer hidden state at the closing boundary of </person_records> . Because this token precedes any prediction questions under causal attention, psychological measurement depends solely on the supplied personal evidence and is invariant to downstream queries.

blocks.en: Our training framework jointly optimizes three supervision objectives within the shared model, linking heterogeneous empirical evidence to psychological construct scores, individual behavioural decisions, and population response distributions ( Fig. 2 ).

blocks.en: 3.3.3 Population alignment
blocks.zh: 3.3.3 人口调整

blocks.en: Population alignment trains Chiron to serve as a calibrated simulator of human cohorts in social science experiments. A central barrier in computational social science is that published experimental studies typically report only condition-level summary statistics (such as sample sizes, means, standard deviations, and treatment effect sizes) rather than raw participant-level responses, while raw LLM completions exhibit severe variance compression and effect-size inflation [ Cui et al., 2025 , Ashokkumar et al., 2026 , Xu et al., 2026 ] . To overcome this barrier, we reconstruct respondent-level supervision from published aggregate human statistics through constrained population synthesis .
blocks.zh: 人口配对训练Chiron作为人类群体在社会科学实验中的校准模拟器. 计算社会科学的一个中心障碍是,公布的实验研究通常只报告条件级汇总统计(如样本大小,手段,标准偏差,以及处理效果大小),而不是原始参与者级响应,而原始的LLM完成则表现出严重的差异压缩和效应大小通胀[Cui等人,2025年,Ashokkumar等人,2026年,Xu等人,2026年]. 为了克服这一障碍,我们通过有限的人口综合,从公布的人类综合统计数据中重建答卷人一级的监督。

blocks.en: 3.4 Mechanistic and methodological advantages
blocks.zh: 3.4 机械和方法优势

blocks.en: Chiron’s architecture and training design address fundamental limitations of both general-purpose LLMs and traditional psychological instruments.
blocks.zh: Chiron的建筑和培训设计解决了一般用途的LLMS和传统心理仪器的基本局限性。

blocks.en:
Off-the-shelf frontier LLMs are optimized for helpful, normative conversational assistance instead of scientific measurement or behavioural simulation. This creates three mechanistic failure modes that Chiron explicitly resolves: 1. Direct latent readout avoids the biases of verbalized scoring. When general LLMs are prompted to score psychological constructs in text, their outputs pass through the autoregressive token generation head, exposing estimates to RLHF-induced social desirability biases that inflate positive traits and compress score dispersion, as well as sensitivity to surrounding irrelevant context and prompt-order recency effects [ Abdurahman et al., 2024 , Ye et al., 2025b , Xu et al., 2026 ] . Chiron bypasses text generation entirely by mapping the person representation directly to continuous scores via a dedicated measurement head ( Eq. 1 ) supervised on psychometric scales and balanced synthetic data. This architectural separation decouples psychological assessment from conversational text generation, avoiding the biases inherent to verbalized scoring. 2. Joint psychometric supervision structures person representations for behavioural prediction. Prior approaches either prompt general LLMs with personal context, which relies on surface lexical cues or demographic stereotypes [ Wang et al., 2025 , Jiang et al., 2025 ] , or fine-tune black-box predictors without construct grounding, which can learn task-specific shortcuts that generalize poorly [ Binz et al., 2025 , Xu et al., 2026 ] . In Chiron, the measurement loss ℒ meas \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{meas}} supervises 109 psychological constructs directly on the shared hidden state h p h_{p} , and the prediction loss ℒ pred \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{pred}} conditions on this same state to predict withheld choices 𝐲 \mathbf{y} . The measurement training thus regularizes h p h_{p} to compress noisy personal records into stable dispositional dimensions that guide downstream prediction, while prediction training ensures that h p h_{p} learns decision-relevant individual signals ( Fig. 5 ). 3. Distributional alignment counteracts mode collapse and restores population dispersion. Preference optimization of general LLMs concentrates a model’s probability mass on modal responses [ Santurkar et al., 2023 , Kirk et al., 2024 , Murthy et al., 2025 ] .
In population simulation, this suppresses within-condition standard deviations, inflates standardized effect sizes, and produces false positives on null findings [ Cui et al., 2025 , Ashokkumar et al., 2026 ] .
Chiron reverses this effect through constrained population synthesis and distributional alignment ( Eqs. 4 and 5 ). Training across the full cohort penalizes over-concentrated outputs and restores calibrated population distribution.

blocks.en: Compared with conventional psychometric questionnaires, laboratory experiments, and narrow text-analysis tools (such as lexicon dictionaries or single-trait classifiers), Chiron offers three distinct methodological advantages for behavioural science: 1. Unified, non-invasive assessment operates across heterogeneous evidence. Traditional psychometric scales require participants to complete fixed, structured item batteries, limiting sample scale and precluding retrospective measurement from naturalistic digital traces, historical texts, or qualitative interviews. Conversely, lexicon tools (e.g., word-count dictionaries) and task-specific classifiers are restricted to narrow trait sets and fail to capture compositional meaning or context. Chiron infers 109 standardized, theory-grounded constructs simultaneously from arbitrary mixtures of unstructured text, behavioural records, and questionnaire response. 2. Shared representations bridge construct interpretability and behavioural predictability. Psychological research has long faced a divide between explanatory construct measurement (which yields interpretable trait profiles but often weakly predicts specific situational choices) and black-box behavioural prediction [ Hofman et al., 2021 , Xu et al., 2026 ] . By coupling an explicit 109-construct measurement head with a generative behavioural predictor on the same person representation, Chiron provides both transparent psychological profiles and accurate predictions of individual behaviour. 3. Calibrated population simulation enables in silico pretesting of experimental designs. Conducting human-subject experiments across many candidate framing conditions, stimuli, or subpopulations is resource-intensive. While uncalibrated LLMs distort effect magnitudes, Chiron’s population alignment enables researchers to pretest experimental protocols, estimate plausible effect sizes and response distributions, and prioritize high-potential hypotheses in silico before deploying confirmatory human studies.

Chiron推断出109种标准化的、理论基础的构造同时来自任意混合的无结构文字、行为记录和问卷答复。 2. 共同表述是构建可解释性和行为可预测性的桥梁。 心理学研究长期面临解释性构造测量(它产生可解释的特征特征特征,但往往对具体的情况选择作出微弱的预测)和黑盒行为预测[Hofman等人,2021年,许等人,2026年]之间的鸿沟. 通过将一个明确的109结构的测量头与同一人代表上的基因行为预测器结合,Chiron既提供了透明的心理剖面,也提供了对个人行为的准确预测. 3. 校准的人口模拟能够对实验设计进行硅预测试。 在许多候选框架条件、刺激或亚人群中进行人类主体实验是资源密集型的。 虽然没有校准的LLMS扭曲了效果的大小,但Chiron的人口配比使研究人员能够预先测试实验协议,估计可能的效果大小和反应分布,并在进行确认性人类研究之前,优先考虑硅中的高潜力假设。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en:
We evaluate Chiron through psychological measurement, individual behavioural prediction, and population simulation.
Measurement examines agreement with human assessments, alignment with literature-derived construct relationships, robustness to irrelevant changes, and responsiveness to experimental manipulations of construct-relevant evidence. Prediction tests responses withheld from personal records, while population simulation compares generated response distributions and experimental effects with human findings. All main evaluations use the same jointly trained model.
Across all three evaluation settings, we compare Chiron with three frontier models (GPT-6 Sol, Claude Opus 5.5 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash) and the unadapted Qwen3.6-35B-A3B base model.

计量审查与人类评估的一致、与文献产生的构建关系的一致性、对不相关变化的稳健性和对与构建相关的证据的试验性操纵的反应。 预测性测试反应不从个人记录中提取,而人口模拟则将产生的响应分布和实验效果与人类发现进行比较. 所有主要评价都采用同样的联合培训模式。
在所有三种评价设置中,我们比较Chiron与三种前沿模型(GPT-6 Sol,Claude Opus 5.5和DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash)和未适应的Qune3.6-35B-A3B基模型.

blocks.en: 4.1.1 Convergent validity
blocks.zh: 4.1.1 同等效力

blocks.en:
Convergent validity measures the agreement between different assessments of the same psychological construct. We compare scores inferred from personal text with self-report assessments completed by the same authors, using Pearson correlation and mean absolute error (MAE). The evaluation spans five datasets (COVID-19 RW3D, Buechel empathy, PANDORA, PsihoRo and Student-SADD) covering nine constructs.
Presented in Fig. 3 a, we calculate Pearson correlation and MAE within each dataset and report the unweighted mean across datasets.
For GPT-6 Sol, 127 requests that were refused after retries are excluded when computing its correlation and MAE.
blocks.zh:
同理有效性衡量对同一心理结构的不同评估之间的一致。 我们用皮尔逊的相互关系和平均绝对错误(MAE)来比较从个人文字中推断出的得分和同一作者完成的自我报告评估. 评价涵盖五个数据集(COVID-19 RW3D、Buechel同情、PANDORA、PsihoRo和学生-SADD),涵盖九个构件。
在图3a中,我们计算了Pearson的关联性和每个数据集的MAE,并报告各数据集的未加权平均值。
对于GPT-6 Sol,在重试后被拒绝的127项请求在计算其相关性和MAE时被排除在外.

blocks.en: Across the five datasets, Chiron achieves a mean Pearson r r of 0.390 and MAE of 0.398, outperforming all four baselines ( r = 0.320 ​ – ​ 0.353 r=0.320\text{--}0.353 and MAE = 0.515 ​ – ​ 0.546 =0.515\text{--}0.546 ). Detailed results by dataset and construct are presented in Table 7 .

blocks.en: 4.1.2 Nomological validity
blocks.zh: 4.1.2 名称有效性

blocks.en: Nomological validity assesses whether relationships among measured constructs agree with established psychological theory and empirical findings [ Cronbach and Meehl, 1955 ] . We examine this by calculating correlations among Chiron’s construct scores across individuals and comparing them against a literature benchmark of median empirical correlations compiled from published psychometric studies. The evaluation covers 150 relationships among 60 constructs, assessed separately across three datasets with distinct record types: PAN15, Essays, and ESS09. The results are plotted in Fig. 3 b. Benchmark construction and evaluation details provided in § C.1.3 .
blocks.zh: 名称学有效性评估测量构造之间的关系是否符合既定的心理理论和经验结论[Cronbach and Meehl,1955]. 我们通过计算Chiron个人的构造分数之间的相关性来研究这个问题,并将它们与从公布的心理计量研究中编译的中位经验性关系文献基准进行比较。 评价涵盖60个构件中的150个关系,分别对3个具有不同记录类型的数据集进行评估:PAN15、Essays和ESS09。 结果在Fig中描绘出来. 3b. 基准构建和评价细节载于C.1.3节。

blocks.en: Across the three datasets, correlations among Chiron’s inferred scores align closely with literature benchmarks, reaching Pearson correlations of 0.816 on PAN15, 0.806 on Essays and 0.819 on ESS09, with sign agreement in 91.3–93.3% of construct pairs ( Table 8 ). This consistency across social-media posts, personal essays, and survey responses indicates that Chiron preserves a coherent nomological structure across different forms of personal evidence.
blocks.zh: 在三个数据集中,Chiron推断得分的关联性与文献基准密切吻合,在PAN15、Essays和ESS09上,皮尔逊的关联性分别达到0.816、0.806和0.819,在91.3-93.3%的构造配对中签下协议(表8)。 社会媒体文章、个人论文和调查答复的这种一致性表明,Chiron保留了不同形式个人证据的一致的名词结构。

blocks.en: 4.1.3 Measurement bias
blocks.zh: 4.1.3 计量偏差

blocks.en:
Measurement bias refers to systematic distortions in inferred scores that are unrelated to the target construct. We examine three types of bias across Fig. 3 c–e:
(1) score compression ( Fig. 3 c), whether inferred scores across individuals are compressed into a narrower range than human self-reports, measured by the ratio of model-score standard deviation to self-report standard deviation averaged across the Big Five traits on PANDORA (where 1 indicates equal dispersion);
(2) irrelevant-context sensitivity ( Fig. 3 d), whether scores drift when construct-irrelevant background statements in the input are replaced while the target evidence is held fixed, measured by the mean absolute score change ( n = 543 n=543 units across all 109 constructs); and
(3) evidence-order sensitivity ( Fig. 3 e), whether scores depend on record ordering, measured by the mean absolute score change when the presentation order of statements in an input is reversed ( n = 540 n=540 units across all 109 constructs).
Evaluation protocols and detailed results are provided in § C.1.4 .
blocks.zh:
测量偏差是指推断出的分数中与目标构造无关的系统性扭曲. 我们审查了图3的三种偏见:
(1) 分数压缩(图3c),个人的推断分数是否压缩到比人类自我报告更窄的范围内,以PANDORA上五大特征平均的模型-分数标准偏差与自我报告标准偏差之比衡量(其中1表示均匀分散);
(2) 不相关的文字敏感性(图3d),输入中与构造相关的背景说明是否在目标证据被固定的情况下被替换时的分数漂移,以平均绝对分数变化(所有109个构造的n = 543 n = 543单位)来衡量;以及
(3)证据-顺序灵敏度(图3 e),分数是否取决于记录顺序,在输入语句的表达顺序被反转时以平均绝对分数变化(n = 540 n = 540单位在所有109个构造中)来衡量.
评价规程和详细结果载于C.1.4节。

blocks.en: On PANDORA ( Fig. 3 c), all models are compressed relative to self-reports, but Chiron reaches a mean standard-deviation ratio of 0.573, remaining closer to human dispersion than the three frontier models (0.383–0.412) and the base model (0.523). The frontier models’ stronger compression relative to both Chiron and the base model corroborates the mechanism discussed in § 3.4 : post-training and preference alignment homogenize verbalized assessments toward modal values [ Kirk et al., 2024 , Murthy et al., 2025 , Xu et al., 2026 ] , whereas Chiron’s centred representation readout better preserves inter-individual dispersion. Under input perturbations ( Fig. 3 d,e), Chiron likewise achieves the smallest mean absolute score changes: 0.0238 when replacing construct-irrelevant context (versus 0.0433–0.0850 across baselines, reducing context-induced drift by 45.0–71.9%) and 0.0270 when reversing evidence order (versus 0.0433–0.1139 across baselines).
blocks.zh: 在PANDORA(图3c)上,所有模型都相对于自我报告进行压缩,但Chiron达到了0.573的平均值标准减速比,与三种前沿模型(0.383–0.412)和基模型(0.523. 前沿模型相对于Chiron和基准模型的更强压缩证实了第3.4节所讨论的机制:培训后和偏好调整将口头评估统一到模式价值[Kirk等人,2024年;Murthy等人,2025年;Xu等人,2026年],而Chiron的核心代表读出则更好地保持个人之间的分散。 在输入扰动(图3 d,e)下,Chiron同样实现了最小的绝对平均得分变化:在替换与构造无关的上下文时为0.0238(在基线中为0.0433-0.850,在上下文引起的漂移减少45.0-71.9%),在反向证据顺序时为0.0270(在基线中为0.0433-0.1139)。

blocks.en: 4.1.4 Experimental manipulation
blocks.zh: 4.1.4 实验操纵

blocks.en: In psychometric validation, a valid measurement instrument must respond predictably to experimental manipulations of construct-relevant evidence while holding background context constant. We conduct controlled interventions that systematically manipulate the diagnostic evidence for a target construct across all 109 constructs: we progressively replace low-level evidence with high-level evidence across four graded levels in questionnaire and narrative inputs, and insert contrasting low- or high-level narratives into otherwise unchanged real personal records. We evaluate stepwise monotonicity as the proportion of adjacent transitions across the four graded manipulation levels in which the score strictly increases, and direction accuracy as the proportion of cases in which the high-evidence manipulation receives a higher score than the low-evidence manipulation. The results are shown in Fig. 3 f,g; experimental setups and detailed results are provided in § C.1.5 .
blocks.zh: 在心理计量验证中,有效的测量仪器必须能够预测对构造相关证据的实验操纵,同时保持背景环境不变。 我们采取有控制的干预措施,系统地操纵所有109个构件的诊断性证据:我们在问卷和叙述性投入中,在四个级别上逐步用高级别证据取代低级证据,并将对比性低级或高级别的叙述性内容纳入本来没有改变的实际个人记录。 我们按四个等级的操纵水平对相邻的过渡比例进行逐级单调性评价,在四个等级的操纵水平上,得分严格增加,方向精确度评价高证据操纵得到比低证据操纵高分的案件比例. 图3 f,g显示了结果;实验设置和详细结果见C.1.5节。

blocks.en: Across all 109 constructs, Chiron’s scores strictly increase across 99.4% of adjacent steps for questionnaire evidence and 94.7% for narrative evidence, compared with 67.2–94.0% and 68.0–94.3% for the four baselines. For direction accuracy, Chiron reaches 100.0% on both questionnaire and narrative manipulations (versus 96.5–99.3% and 98.5–99.7% for the baselines) and 93.8% when contrasting narratives are inserted into real personal records (versus 87.6–96.4% for the baselines).
blocks.zh: 在所有109个构思中,Chiron的分数严格上升了99.4%的相邻问卷证据步骤和94.7%的叙述性证据步骤,而四个基线的分数分别为67.2-94.0%和68.0-94.3%。 关于方向准确性,Chiron在问卷和叙述操作上达到100.0%(基线为96.5-99.3%和98.5-99.7%),在真实的个人记录中插入对比叙述时达到93.8%(基线为87.6-96.4%)。

blocks.en: 4.2 Individual behavioural prediction
blocks.zh: 4.2 个人行为预测

blocks.en:
We evaluate whether Chiron can predict a person’s withheld responses, choices, or behavioural attributes, based on their available personal records. The benchmark spans 29 behavioural domains and examines two generalization settings:
(1) held-out individuals , which tests unseen participants (or source records) across the 25 domains included in behavioural prediction training;
and (2) held-out domains , which tests four additional domains excluded from behavioural prediction training (HEXACO, MACH-IV, RIASEC and SAPA-2022).
All models receive the same observed records and target questions. The test set contains 4,767 cases: 3,967 cases in the 25 represented domains and 800 cases in the four held-out domains. We compute prediction accuracy for each test case (the proportion of withheld target questions answered correctly for that person) and report the mean and standard error of the mean (SEM) across cases within each domain. For GPT-6 Sol, 60 requests that were refused after retries are excluded when computing its mean accuracy, whereas malformed outputs (two Blog cases for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B) are scored as zero. Domain-level results across both generalization settings are presented in Fig. 4 , with further details provided in § C.2 .
blocks.zh:
我们根据Chiron的个人记录来评估他是否能够预测他的反应、选择或行为属性。 该基准跨越29个行为领域,并审查两个概括设置:
(1) 被扣留的个人,在行为预测培训包括的25个领域测试未见的参与者(或来源记录);
和(2)搁置领域,测试行为预测培训中不包括的另外四个领域(HEXACO、MACH-IV、RIASEC和SAPA-2022)。
所有模型都收到相同的观测记录和目标问题. 该套测试包括4 767个案例:25个代表领域的3 967个案例和四个搁置领域的800个案例。 我们计算每个测试案例的预测准确性(被扣目标问题的比例对该人正确回答),并报告每个领域中平均(SEM)案例的平均值和标准误差。 对于GPT-6 Sol,在重试后被拒绝的60项请求在计算其平均准确度时被排除在外,而错误的输出(Qune3.6-35B-A3B的两个博客案例)则被评为零. 图4列出了两种通用设置的域级结果,第C.2节提供了进一步的细节。

blocks.en:
Across all 29 domains, Chiron reaches a mean prediction accuracy of 0.504 (averaging equally across domains), compared with 0.382–0.418 for the four baselines, and ranks first in 28 of the 29 domains.
This advantage holds across both generalization levels: on held-out individuals within the 25 represented domains, Chiron attains a mean prediction accuracy of 0.522 (versus 0.389–0.425 for the baselines), and on the four held-out domains excluded from prediction training, it remains the top-performing model on every domain with a mean prediction accuracy of 0.391 (versus 0.312–0.370).
blocks.zh:
在所有29个域中,Chiron的平均预测精度达到0.504(平均跨域),而四个基线为0.382-0.418,在29个域中排名第28位。
在一般化两个层面都具有这一优势:在25个代表域内被搁置的个人中,Chiron的平均预测精度为0.522(基线为0.389-0.425),在被排除在预测培训之外的4个被搁置域中,它仍然是每个域中表现最优的模型,平均预测精度为0.391(0.312-0.370)。

blocks.en: To examine how psychometric supervision and latent construct measurement support downstream behavioural prediction ( § 3.4 ), we trace Chiron’s construct readouts at </person_records> and its item-level predictions across four graded evidence levels (L1–L4) in two settings ( Fig. 5 ).
blocks.zh: 为了审查心理计量监督和潜在构造测量如何支持下游的行为预测(第3.4节),我们追踪了Chiron在 </person_records > 的构造读数及其在两种情况下(图5)的四级证据水平(L1-L4)的项目级预测。

blocks.en:
(1) We conduct a cross-domain counterfactual case study on naturalistic personal records ( Fig. 5 a–d). Here, we hold three everyday routine notes fixed and progressively replace three unstructured habits in task scheduling, personal finances, and work organization with structured alternatives from L1 ( 0 / 3 0/3 structured) to L4 ( 3 / 3 3/3 structured) ( Fig. 5 a).
Conditioning on the person representation at </person_records> , we read out Chiron’s construct scores ( Fig. 5 b) and compare expected, predicted option ratings E ⁡ [ y ] = ∑ k = 1 5 k ​ p ​ ( y = k ∣ ℛ p , q ) E[y]=\sum_{k=1}^{5}k\,p(y=k\mid\mathcal{R}_{p},q) between Chiron and the unadapted Qwen3.6-35B-A3B base model. Two models predict item response on a held-out vocational domain (Holland’s RIASEC inventory, rating job activity “Maintain employee records” from 1 = Dislike to 5 = Enjoy; Fig. 5 c) and a reverse-keyed future-orientation item (Consideration of Future Consequences Scale, CFCS, “I only act to satisfy immediate concerns, figuring the future will take care of itself” ; Fig. 5 d).
blocks.zh:
(1) 我们对自然主义个人记录进行跨领域反事实案例研究(图5 a-d)。 在这里,我们持有三个日常的日常笔记,固定并逐步取代任务时间安排、个人财务和工作安排中的三个无结构的习惯,代之以从L1(0 / 3 0/3结构)到L4(3 / 3/3结构)(图5a)的结构化替代。
我们以 " /人_记录 " 的个人代表身份为条件,宣读Chiron的构造分数(图5b),并比较预期的、预测的选项评分E = = = = = = = 1 5 k p (y = k = = = = = = R p, q ) E[y]=\sum_{k=1}^{5}k\,p(y=k\mid\mathcal{R}_{p},q) 在Chiron和未适应的Qwen3.6-35B-A3B基模之间. 两个模型预测了对一个被搁置的职业领域的项目反应(Holland ' s RIASEC存货,将工作活动评为 " 雇员记录 " 从1=不相似到5=享受;图5c)和一个面向未来的反键项目(考虑未来后果规模,CFCS, " 我的行动只是为了解决眼前的问题,想未来会照顾自己 " ;图5d)。

blocks.en:
(2) We extend the case study to a systematic within-instrument test across all 109 constructs ( Fig. 5 e). For each construct, we pair each of five synthetic backgrounds with three item responses. Keeping the background fixed, we change these responses one at a time from the lowest- to the highest-scoring answer, creating four evidence levels (L1–L4).
For each input, Chiron measures the construct and predicts responses to three other target items. The five backgrounds and four levels yield 2,180 inputs and 6,540 item predictions across all constructs.
Experimental setups and evaluation details are provided in § C.2.3 .
blocks.zh:
(2) 我们把案例研究扩大到对所有109个构件进行系统的内部测试(图5e)。 对于每一种构造,我们把五个合成背景中的每一个组合成三个项目响应。 在保持背景不变的同时,我们将这些回复从最低的回复改为最高的回复,形成四个证据级别(L1-L4)。
对于每个输入,Chiron测量构造并预测对另外三个目标项的反应. 5个背景和4个层次共产生2 180项投入和6 540项预测,涵盖所有构造。
第C.2.3节提供了实验设置和评价细节。

blocks.en:
In the counterfactual case study, Chiron’s inferred conscientiousness increases monotonically across levels ( − 0.33 → − 0.02 → + 0.40 → + 0.89 -0.33\to-0.02\to+0.40\to+0.89 ) alongside Holland’s conventional vocational interest, which captures preference for orderly, rule-governed clerical work ( − 0.37 → − 0.10 → + 0.33 → + 0.81 -0.37\to-0.10\to+0.33\to+0.81 ). As a comparison, an unrelated trait (extraversion) remains flat near zero ( − 0.02 -0.02 to + 0.11 +0.11 ). Given the same personal records, Chiron’s expected option ratings shift smoothly and monotonically on both the held-out RIASEC item ( 2.26 → 2.87 → 3.57 → 4.35 2.26\to 2.87\to 3.57\to 4.35 ; Fig. 5 c) and the reverse-keyed CFCS item ( 3.69 → 2.88 → 1.79 → 1.49 3.69\to 2.88\to 1.79\to 1.49 ; Fig. 5 d).
By contrast, the unadapted Qwen3.6-35B-A3B base model fails to integrate graded behavioural evidence and exhibits a pronounced extreme-option selection bias characteristic of general-purpose LLMs on Likert-type scales. Instead of calibrating intermediate ratings to mixed evidence, it collapses probability mass onto the scale endpoints (1 or 5), remaining near the floor on the held-out RIASEC item across L1–L3 ( 1.12 → 1.11 → 1.25 1.12\to 1.11\to 1.25 ) before jumping abruptly to 4.96 4.96 at L4, and switching sharply between opposite extremes on the CFCS item ( 4.98 → 4.65 4.98\to 4.65 versus 1.24 → 1.00 1.24\to 1.00 ).

To examine whether the construct score accounts for the prediction itself, we treat each construct’s 20 records, formed by crossing its five backgrounds with the four evidence levels, as separate observations. Within each construct, we first regress the mean prediction score on the construct score alone, and then repeat the regression after adding the evidence level, coded as 0, 1, 2 and 3. blocks.en: 4.3 Population simulation

blocks.en:
We evaluate whether simulated populations reproduce human response distributions and experimental effects across social science experiments. The benchmark splits studies into 63 training studies and 15 held-out test studies; all conditions from a study remain in the same split, and only training studies contribute to population synthesis and joint training. Across the 15 test studies, each model generates 4,277 planned virtual participants over 45 experimental conditions, following the replication protocol of Cui et al. [2025] .
We apply each study’s original scoring procedure to compare simulated and human outcomes in terms of effect magnitudes (Cohen’s d d MAE and Pearson correlation), effect direction accuracy, statistical significance F1, and normalized mean absolute error (NMAE) of response distributions. For Claude Opus 5.5, 98 refused requests are not imputed. GPT-6 Sol, Claude Opus 5.5 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash each have one zero-variance condition pair in AMJ_4_2. Results across the 15 held-out studies are presented in Fig. 6 , with further details provided in § C.3 .

blocks.en: Across the 15 held-out studies, Chiron substantially outperforms all four baselines on four of the five evaluation metrics. For treatment effect estimation, Chiron reduces Cohen’s d d MAE to 0.224 (compared with 0.798–3.895 for the baselines) and reaches an effect-size correlation of r = 0.873 r=0.873 (versus 0.540–0.703), while achieving the highest effect direction accuracy at 90.5% (versus 78.6–83.3%). It also matches human response distributions more closely, with a distribution NMAE of 0.0755 compared with 0.1248–0.1638 for the baselines.

blocks.en:
Notably, stronger frontier models exhibit larger distributional and effect-size distortions than the unadapted base model: Cohen’s d d MAE increases monotonically from 0.798 for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B to 1.254–3.895 across the three frontier models, accompanied by a parallel rise in distribution NMAE (with the three frontier models even collapsing to zero within-condition variance in AMJ_4_2). This pattern directly reflects the mechanism analysed in §§ 1 and 3.4 : standard instruction tuning and preference alignment suppress within-condition response variance and homogenize simulated participants, which systematically inflates standardized effect sizes ( d d , where between-condition mean differences are divided by pooled within-condition standard deviation).
This mechanism also explains why Chiron obtains a lower statistical significance F1 than the baselines (0.678 versus 0.741–0.785 across the 53 tests). Because published experimental benchmarks consist predominantly of statistically significant findings ( p < 0.05 p<0.05 ) and the F1 metric rewards true positives while ignoring true negatives, models that indiscriminately produce small p p -values are systematically favoured. By underestimating within-condition variance and exaggerating treatment effects, the four baselines declare 19–22 more comparisons statistically significant than Chiron, raising true positives from 20 to 29–31 but correctly identifying only 2–5 true negatives on null human effects (compared with 14 for Chiron). In contrast, Chiron preserves realistic response dispersion and produces more conservative, better-calibrated effect magnitudes.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion and Discussion
blocks.zh: 结论和讨论

blocks.en: We introduced Chiron, a foundation model to measure and predict human behaviour that jointly learns psychological measurement, individual behavioural prediction, and population alignment within a shared language model. Combining psychometric supervision, self-supervised masked observation prediction, and constrained population synthesis enables scalable learning from heterogeneous individual records and aggregate study statistics. Across our evaluations, Chiron produces more accurate and psychometrically valid construct measurements than frontier LLMs, recovering literature-derived nomological networks while mitigating score compression, irrelevant-context drift, and evidence-order sensitivity. For individual prediction, Chiron outperforms frontier models across 29 behavioural domains (up to 28.4% relative improvement), generalizing to both unseen individuals and held-out domains. In population simulations across 15 held-out social science experiments, it counteracts the variance collapse of aligned frontier LLMs and reduces effect-size estimation error by 82.2–94.3%. Together, these findings establish Chiron as a unified computational instrument for measuring psychological attributes and predicting human behaviour across individual and population scales.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了Chiron, 一个衡量和预测人类行为的基础模型, 它共同学习心理测量, 个人行为预测, 以及人口在共同语言模型中的一致性。 结合心理计量监督、自我监督的蒙面观测预测和受限制的人口合成,能够从不同的个人记录和综合研究统计中进行可扩展的学习。 通过我们的评价,Chiron比Frontial LLMS更准确、更具有精神力的构造测量,恢复文献产生的名词网络,同时减轻积分压缩、无关紧要的文字漂移和证据顺序敏感性。 就个人预测而言,Chiron超越了29个行为领域的前沿模型(相对改善率高达28.4%),将其概括到看不见的个人和被搁置的领域。 在涉及15个搁置的社会科学实验的人口模拟中,它抵消了对齐边疆域有限责任公司的差异崩溃,并将效果大小估计误差减少了82.2-94.3%。 这些发现共同将Chiron确立为测量个人和人口尺度的心理属性和预测人类行为的统一计算工具.

blocks.en:
In § 1 , we outlined four methodological challenges that limit general-purpose LLMs in psychology and computational social science. Our empirical findings show promise for addressing each challenge: • Decoupled latent readouts mitigate psychometric biases in unstructured assessment. Off-the-shelf LLMs suffer from social-desirability inflation, variance compression, and framing sensitivity when verbalizing psychological measurement through text generation [ Abdurahman et al., 2024 , Ye et al., 2025b , Brickman et al., 2025 ] . Chiron’ architecture measures constructs directly from person representations, bypassing token generation. This design yields closer agreement with human self-reports, alignment with literature-derived construct relationships, fuller inter-individual score dispersion, smaller drift under irrelevant context and evidence-order changes, and monotonic responses to experimental manipulations of construct-relevant evidence ( Fig. 3 ). • Jointly learning construct readouts and behavioural prediction reconciles interpretability with predictability. Bridging explanatory psychological constructs and out-of-sample behavioural prediction has been a longstanding challenge [ Hofman et al., 2021 ] . Joint supervision on a shared person representation yields transparent trait profiles and accurate predictions of withheld behavior ( Fig. 4 ).
Trait scores and predicted item answers shift together when trait-related evidence strengthens ( Fig. 5 ), suggesting measurement and prediction draw on the same information. The same person representation thus links interpretable traits to the choices the model predicts. • Distributional alignment mitigates homogenization and variance collapse in simulated populations. Heavily posttrained frontier LLMs often collapse within-condition variance and exaggerate standardized treatment effects in experimental simulation [ Kozlowski and Evans, 2025 , Ashokkumar et al., 2026 , Cui et al., 2025 ] . Constrained population synthesis trains Chiron to match human statistics. It produces more realistic response distributions, better-calibrated effect magnitudes, and fewer false positives on null human findings ( Fig. 6 ). These results point toward the potential of using Chiron-driven simulations to pretest experimental designs, screen survey instruments, and gauge plausible effect sizes before confirmatory human studies. • Self-supervision and synthetic data mitigate privacy and data-access constraints. Our results suggest that Chiron can be trained and calibrated without raw participant-level experimental releases or exhaustive psychometric labels on every record [ Xu et al., 2026 ] . For measurement training, psychometrically labelled human text is scarce. We generate first-person stories for all 109 constructs and fits measurement supervision from pairwise-calibrated construct scores.
For prediction training, masked observation prediction allows learning individual behaviour from unlabelled personal writing.
For distributional alignment, constrained population synthesis fits virtual respondents to published human statistics.

blocks.en: We note several methodological scope boundaries and directions for extension. First, our measurement head uses a fixed inventory of 109 constructs instead of open-ended trait descriptions. These 109 constructs are curated from established psychometric taxonomies ( Table 4 ) to provide broad, non-redundant coverage across five core domains of human variation: personality and vocational interests, self-evaluation and interpersonal functioning, affect and mental health, moral and cultural values, and cognitive self-regulation. This inventory offers sufficient theoretical completeness to represent individual differences. Second, our behavioural prediction objective targets structured choices, ratings, and classifications rather than free-text generation. Focusing on structured decisions removes surface linguistic confounds, enables exact evaluation against human ground truth, and matches standard survey and experimental formats. Extending Chiron to open-ended dialogue and free-form behavioural generation is an important next step. Third, our model encodes a person’s records as a static snapshot. Incorporating longitudinal timestamps will help separate stable traits from transient states over time.
blocks.zh: 我们注意到若干方法范围界限和扩展方向。 首先,我们的测量头使用109个建筑的固定清单,而不是开放式特征描述。 这109个构件是从既定的心理计量分类法(表4)中归纳出来的,目的是在人类变化的五个核心领域提供广泛、非重复的覆盖:个性和职业利益、自我评价和人际功能、影响和心理健康、道德和文化价值以及认知自我调节。 这份清单提供了足以代表个人差异的理论完整性。 其次,我们的行为预测客观目标是结构化的选择、评级和分类,而不是自由文本生成。 注重结构化决策可以消除表面语言上的混乱,能够根据人类地面的真相进行准确评价,并符合标准调查和实验格式。 将Chiron扩展至开放式对话和自由形式的行为生成,是下一步的一个重要步骤。 第三,我们的模型将一个人的记录编码为静态快照。 采用纵向时间戳将有助于随着时间推移将稳定特征与过渡状态区分开来。

blocks.en: Models that infer psychological attributes and predict human behaviour carry dual-use risks that require clear boundaries. First, psychological inference from digital traces must respect informed consent and autonomy. Chiron is built for scientific research only, and must not be used for unauthorized profiling, covert surveillance, or high-stakes automated decisions in hiring, credit, insurance, or clinical diagnosis. Second, because inferring individual dispositions and framing effects could enable targeted persuasion or manipulation, personalized AI systems using psychometric representations require human oversight and safeguards against manipulative steering. Third, in population simulation, calibrated in silico cohorts are designed for hypothesis generation and experimental pretesting. Validation with real human subjects remains essential before drawing scientific conclusions.
blocks.zh: 推断心理属性和预测人类行为的模型具有双重用途风险,需要明确的界限。 首先,数字痕迹的心理推断必须尊重知情同意和自主。 Chiron仅用于科研,不得用于未经授权的剖析,隐蔽监视,或在雇用,信用,保险,或临床诊断中高端的自动决策. 第二,由于推断个人的处置和框架效应可以促成有针对性地说服或操纵,使用心理计量表示的个性化AI系统需要人为监督和防止操纵性引导的保障。 第三,在人口模拟中,硅基组群的校准是为假设生成和实验性预测试而设计的. 在得出科学结论之前,对真正的人类主体进行验证仍然至关重要。

blocks.en: B.1 Data synthesis for measurement training
blocks.zh: B.1 计量培训数据综合

blocks.en: We construct 10,900 synthetic questionnaire records to train the measurement head. For each record, we sample up to ten distinct items from one construct’s item pool and then generate their responses. To keep responses within a record broadly consistent, we first draw a value from a uniform distribution to represent the record’s intended construct level. We then use Gaussian-based sampling around this shared value to select a response to each item, accounting for its scoring direction and available response options. This introduces variation across individual answers while preserving a common underlying tendency. In 10% of records, responses are instead sampled independently and uniformly from the available options. Once the responses have been generated, we calculate the supervision target by mapping them to [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] , applying reverse scoring where required, and averaging the item scores. The resulting records are presented either as explicit item–response pairs or as natural-language statements produced by fixed templates. Finally, we remove duplicate records and sample across score bins to retain 100 records per construct, covering the full range of construct levels.
blocks.zh: 我们构建了10,900个合成问卷记录来训练测量头. 每一份记录,我们从一个建筑项目库中抽取最多10个不同的项目,然后提出答复。 为了使答复在记录中大致一致,我们首先从统一分配中提取价值,以表示记录的预期构造水平。 然后我们用高斯的样本 围绕这个共享值来选择每个项目的响应, 考虑它的评分方向和可用的响应选项。 这在保持共同的基本趋势的同时,也给个人答复带来了差异。 在10%的记录中,答复是独立和统一地从现有选择中抽取的。 一旦生成答复,我们就通过将监测目标映射到[− 1, 1] [-1, 1] ,在需要时采用反向评分,并平均得分来计算监督目标. 由此产生的记录要么作为明确的项目-对答,要么作为用固定模板制作的自然语言报表。 最后,我们删除了重复记录和跨分数箱的样本,以保留每个构造的100个记录,涵盖全部构造水平.

blocks.en: We use DeepSeek-V4-Pro to generate 25,000 candidate narratives across the 109 constructs. Each request supplies a construct definition together with generation conditions grounded in real-world scenarios. We balance the six combinations of aligned or opposing direction and weak, medium or strong evidence. The texts cover ten everyday contexts, including work or study, family life, social interactions, online communication, leisure, daily routines, conflict, setbacks and personal decisions. They take the form of concrete episodes, preferences or opinions, and self-reflections in a 5:3:2 ratio. Requested lengths are 8–99, 100–250 and 250–500 words, in a 3:3:2 ratio. The model writes each narrative independently and is instructed to express the relevant behaviour or experience without explicitly naming the psychological construct or reporting a score. The generation system and user prompts are given below.
blocks.zh: 我们使用DeepSeek-V4-Pro,在109个构件中生成25 000个候选叙述。 每项请求都提供了建筑定义以及基于现实世界情景的生成条件。 我们平衡了对齐或对立方向和薄弱、中等或有力证据的六种组合。 这些文本涵盖十种日常背景,包括工作或学习、家庭生活、社会互动、在线通信、休闲、日常活动、冲突、挫折和个人决定。 它们采取具体事件、偏好或意见,以及以5:3:2的比例自我反思的形式。 要求的长度为8–99,100–250和250–500字,比例为3:3:2. 模型独立写每个叙事,并被指示表达相关行为或经历,而不明确命名心理构造或报告一个分数. 生成系统和用户提示如下。

blocks.en: System prompt You write natural English posts and comments for a controlled text dataset. INPUT FORMAT The user supplies one target construct, its aligned-direction definition, and a JSON array of slots. Each slot contains: - slot_id: an identifier that must be copied exactly; - target_direction: "aligned" or "opposing"; - strength: "weak", "medium", or "strong"; - context: the setting for the text; - expression_mode: the requested form of writing; - word_range: the requested inclusive word-count range. OUTPUT FORMAT Return only one valid JSON object with exactly this shape: {"items": [{"slot_id": "...", "text": "..."}]} Return exactly one item for every input slot, in the same order, and no extra items. Each item must contain only slot_id and text. Preserve every slot_id exactly. The text must be a JSON string with no surrounding commentary. CONTENT RULES The text is the author’s post itself, not a description of a post. Never include a psychological label, score, intensity label, explanation, heading, bullet, or wrapper such as "I posted on Reddit". Ordinary words that happen to overlap a construct name may still be used naturally; do not explicitly classify the author. Do not imitate a questionnaire item. Use plausible everyday language rather than polished fiction. Every text must fall within its requested inclusive word_range; count words as whitespace-separated tokens. Before returning, verify the length and expand or trim neutral setting and narrative detail as needed without changing the requested direction or evidential strength. Let sentence count and structure follow the requested word_range and the natural content. Each slot has four independent controls: - target_direction: whether the text should indicate the "aligned" direction described by the definition or its "opposing" direction; - strength: how diagnostic the evidence should be; - context: the ordinary setting in which the evidence appears; - expression_mode: the linguistic form in which the evidence is expressed. Strength describes diagnostic evidence, not dramatic wording: - weak: exactly one mild, situational, directionally interpretable clue; do not reinforce it with repeated examples, broad self-descriptions, strong emotion, or a consequential choice; - medium: clear ordinary evidence, stronger than a passing clue but limited in scope and without exaggeration; - strong: decisive, repeated, pervasive, or consequential evidence that remains realistic. Apply these distinctions symmetrically to both directions. For each strength, use only the corresponding level of diagnostic evidence described above in the requested direction. Derive all construct-specific content, including opposing implications, solely from the supplied definition. Word count controls narrative length, not evidential strength. Longer texts may add setting and neutral detail, but must not accumulate extra construct-relevant examples merely to fill space. A long weak item must remain weak, and a short strong item may remain strong through one decisive or consequential clue. Expression modes: - concrete_episode: one observable event, choice, action, or reaction; - preference_or_opinion: a natural first-person preference, choice, or view; - self_reflection: a recurring personal pattern noticed by the author without naming a construct. Every item must provide clean, directionally interpretable evidence for the requested direction of the target construct. Do not include behavior that clearly supports the other direction, and do not make another psychological construct equally salient. An opposing-direction item must contain affirmative evidence for an opposing pattern implied by the supplied definition. It must not rely only on omitting aligned-direction behavior. A weak item must still be interpretable; weak means subtle, not irrelevant. Write every item independently. Vary situations, syntax, openings, activities, and details. Do not create mirrored, counterfactual, or template-like pairs.
blocks.zh: 系统提示 您为受控文本数据集撰写自然的英文帖和注释 。 输入格式 用户提供一种目标构造、其对齐方向定义和JSON槽阵列。 每个插槽包含: - 槽_id: 一个必须准确复制的标识符; - 目标_方向:"对齐"或"对齐"; - 强度:"弱","中等",或"强"; - 上下文:文本的设置; - 表达_模式:请求的书写形式; - 单词_范围:请求的包容性字数范围. 输出格式 只返回一个完全按此形状有效的 JSON 对象 : {'items' : [{'slot_id' : "...", "text": "...}}} 以相同的顺序返回每个输入槽的完全一个项,没有附加项。 每个项目只必须包含槽_id和文本. 保护每个插槽 准确的。 文本必须是JSON字符串,没有周围的评论. 规则 内容是作者的帖子本身,而不是对帖子的描述. 绝不包括心理标签,分数,强度标签,解释,标题,子弹,或包装,如"我在Reddit上发布". 偶然与构造名称重叠的普通词仍然可以自然使用;没有明确地将作者分类. 不要模仿问卷项目。 使用可信的日常语言而不是抛光的虚构。 每个文本必须属于其请求的包含的单词_范围;将单词计为白空分隔符号. 在返回前,核查长度,并根据需要扩展或修剪中性设置和叙述细节,同时不改变所要求的方向或证据强度. 让句子计数和结构遵循请求的单词_距离和自然内容. 每个槽有四个独立的控制器: - 目标_方向: 文本是否应该表示定义所描述的"对应"方向或其"对立"方向; - 强度:证据应如何诊断; - 上下文:证据出现时的普通环境; - 表达式_模式:证据表达时的语言形式. 强力描述诊断性证据,而非戏剧性的措辞: - 弱:完全一个温和,情况性,方向性可解释的线索; 不用重复的例子,广义的自我描述,强烈的情感,或相应的选择来强化它; - 中等:清晰的普通证据,比传递的线索更强,但范围有限,且不夸张; - 强:决定性的,重复的,普遍存在的,或相应的证据,仍然是现实的. 将这些区分对称地适用于两个方向。 对于每种强度,仅使用上述相应水平的诊断证据,按要求方向进行. 仅从提供的定义衍生出所有特定构件的内容,包括相反的影响。 单词计数控制叙述长度,而不是证据强度. 较长的文本可能添加设置和中性细节,但不得仅仅为填充空格而积累额外的构造相关实例. 长期弱项必须保持弱项,短暂强项可能通过一个决定性或必然的线索保持强项. 表达模式: - 具体_集:一个可观察到的事件,选择,动作,或反应; - 偏好_或_opinion:一个自然的第一人称偏好,选择,或视图; - 自我_反省:一个作者在不命名一个构造的情况下注意到的反复出现的个人模式. 每件物品都必须为目标构造要求的方向提供清洁、可定向解释的证据。 不包括明显支持其他方向的行为,也不使另一种心理构造同样突出. 反对方向项目必须包含对所提供定义所暗示的相反模式的肯定证据。 它决不能仅仅依赖于忽略对齐方向的行为. 弱项仍然必须能够解释;弱项意味着微妙,而不是无关紧要。 独立写每个项目 。 变化情况,语法,开篇,活动,以及细节. 不要创建镜像、反事实或类似模板的对。

blocks.en: User prompt Target construct: {construct_name} Authoritative aligned-direction definition: {definition_en} "Aligned" means the direction described by the definition, and "opposing" means the direction opposed to that definition. Strength alone controls the amount of diagnostic evidence. Both directions require affirmative evidence in their requested direction; mere absence of evidence for the other direction is not sufficient. If the construct names a symptom, risk, or socially undesirable tendency, do not reverse the directions for desirability. Use each requested context only as a setting and each expression_mode only as the form of writing. Across the batch, vary which behavioral or attitudinal implication of the definition supplies the evidence when the definition permits that variation. Generate exactly one independent text for every slot below. Each final text must be within its inclusive word_range. Verify every item’s word count before returning, and preserve every slot_id exactly. {slots_json}

blocks.en: Following ValueFlow [ Kim et al., 2026 ] , we derive continuous scores from pairwise comparisons of the generated texts. Each candidate is compared with 20 distinct, randomly sampled candidates for the same construct, appearing ten times in each presentation position. DeepSeek-V4-Flash judges which text places its author further toward the direction specified by the construct definition, using temperature zero and returning an A/B choice for each comparison. The resulting 500,000 judgments are fitted separately for each construct with a Bradley–Terry model, using a comparison temperature of 0.15, scores bounded within [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] , and a mean-zero constraint. Candidate selection considers score uncertainty, agreement with the comparison judgments, stability when scores are refitted on disjoint subsets of comparisons, and consistency with the requested direction. We also remove irrelevant texts, explicit psychological labels and duplicate narratives. We then sample across score bins to cover the full range of construct levels while maintaining diversity in context, expression form and length, retaining 50, 100 or 200 narratives per construct (15,250 measurement-training records in total) with their fitted scores as supervision targets. The comparison system and user prompts are given below.
blocks.zh: 以下数值 Flow[Kim et al., 2026],我们通过对生成的文本进行对等比较得出连续的分数. 将每个候选人与20个不同、随机抽查的同一结构候选人进行比较,在每个列报职位上出现10次。 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 判断器的文本使其作者进一步朝构造定义指定的方向前进,使用温度0并返回每次比较的A/B选择. 所产生的500 000个判断结果分别装有布拉德利-泰利模型,比较温度为0.15,分数以[− 1, 1] [-1, 1] 为限,并且是中零限制。 候选人的甄选考虑分数的不确定性,同意比较判断,在比较分数重排不相连子集时保持稳定,并与要求的方向保持一致。 我们还删除无关的文字,明确的心理标签和重复的叙述. 然后,我们通过分数箱进行抽样,以涵盖整个构造水平,同时保持上下文、表达形式和长度的多样性,保留每构造的50、100或200个叙述(总共15 250个测量-训练记录),并将其作为监督目标。 比较系统和用户提示如下。

blocks.en: System prompt You are a careful psychometric pairwise rater. For each comparison, decide which text places its author relatively further toward the direction specified by the supplied definition. Neither side is designated as the positive or negative example. Do not assume that either side must strongly express the construct. A text may provide definition-aligned evidence, definition-opposing evidence, or no relevant evidence. Base the comparison only on construct-relevant evidence expressed in the text. Do not use writing quality, topic, general sentiment, moral approval, social desirability, or stereotypes as substitutes for the construct. For constructs that describe symptoms, risks, or undesirable tendencies, the definition-aligned direction remains the defined tendency, not the more desirable person. Treat a text with no construct-relevant evidence as neutral for this comparison. Therefore, definition-aligned evidence ranks above neutral, and neutral ranks above definition-opposing evidence. These directions do not indicate whether the content is positive, negative, desirable, or undesirable. Use one ordered continuum: stronger opposing evidence < weaker opposing evidence < neutral < weaker aligned evidence < stronger aligned evidence. Always select the text farther toward the definition-aligned end of this continuum. Thus, when both texts contain opposing evidence, select the one with weaker opposing evidence; when both contain aligned evidence, select the one with stronger aligned evidence. You must choose A or B. Do not return ties, confidence ratings, explanations, or any text outside the required JSON object. Evaluate every comparison independently. Return exactly: {"comparisons":[{"pair_id":"...","winner":"A"}]} Return one result for every pair_id in the original order. Preserve every pair_id exactly and use only "A" or "B" as winner.
