blocks.en: B.2 Data synthesis for prediction training
blocks.zh: B.2 预测培训数据综合

blocks.en:
For prediction tasks derived from unlabelled personal writing, we use DeepSeek-V3.2 to extract discrete observations from individual texts. The extraction prompt asks for first-person statements about stable habits, interests, emotional tendencies, values or personality tendencies, each supported by an explicit quotation from the source text. We retain the extracted statements and pool them by author, together with available demographic descriptions. Approximately one quarter of the statements are randomly withheld, while the remaining records form the prediction input. Each withheld statement is then submitted separately to the same model to generate a four-option question and its reference answer. The prompt asks for either a fine-grained distinction between related behaviours or an abstract characterization of the underlying tendency, together with three plausible distractors. We parse the generated question, shuffle its options and update the reference answer accordingly.
For prediction tasks, Chiron receives the remaining records and generated questions, with the withheld statements excluded from its input. The extraction and question-generation prompts are given below.
blocks.zh:
对于无标签的个人写作所产生的预测任务,我们使用DeepSeek-V3.2从单个文本中提取离散的观察. 提取提示请求第一人称声明,涉及稳定的习惯,兴趣,情感倾向,价值观或个性倾向,每篇声明都有来源文本的明确引用支持. 我们保留所摘取的陈述,并将这些陈述连同现有的人口描述汇集在一起。 大约四分之一的报表是随机扣留的,其余记录则构成预测输入。 然后将每个被扣报表分别提交给同一个模型,以产生一个四个选项问题及其参考答案。 该提示要求要么在相关行为之间作出细微的区分,要么抽象地描述基本趋势,同时提出三个可能分散注意力的因素。 我们分析产生的问题,洗刷其选项,并相应更新参考答案.
对于预测任务,Chiron接收了剩余的记录并产生了问题,而其输入中不包括被扣的对账单. 提取和生成问题提示如下。

blocks.en: Observation extraction You are a research assistant trained in computational social science. Your task is to extract ALL HIGH-CONFIDENCE personality-related features from a single blog post. --- STRICT RULES: 1. You must base your conclusions ONLY on explicit textual evidence. 2. You must NOT speculate or infer beyond what is clearly supported. 3. You may extract MULTIPLE features, but ONLY if each one is strongly supported. 4. If no feature is strongly supported, return an empty list. 5. Avoid clinical or medical diagnosis. 6. Be conservative: when in doubt, do NOT include the feature. --- DEFINITION: A "feature" may include ONE of the following: - A behavioral pattern (habit, routine) - A stable interest - A personality tendency (ONLY if clearly supported) - A recurring emotional tendency - A clear value or belief --- OUTPUT FORMAT (STRICT): Return ONLY a JSON object: { "features": [ { "feature": "A first-person declarative sentence (e.g., ’I tend to stay up late and struggle to wake up early.’)", "category": "behavior | interest | personality | emotion | value", "evidence": ["short quote"], "confidence": "high" } ] } OR: { "features": [] } --- ADDITIONAL CONSTRAINTS: - Each feature MUST be written in FIRST PERSON ("I ...") - Each MUST be a complete declarative sentence - Each MUST reflect a stable tendency, not a one-time event - Evidence must be a direct quote (max 20 words) - ONLY include features with HIGH confidence - Do NOT include weak or ambiguous traits - Do NOT explain your reasoning - Do NOT summarize the blog --- DATA: <BLOG_HERE>
blocks.zh: 观察提取 你是接受计算社会科学培训的研究助理 你的任务是从一个博客文章中提取所有与高冲突有关的个性特征。 - 严格规则: 1. 您的结论只能以明确的文字证据为依据。 2. 不得猜测或推断超出明确支持的范围。 3. 您可以提取 MULTIPLE 特性, 但只有每个特性都得到有力支持。 4. 如果没有强烈支持的特性,请返回一个空列表。 5. 避免临床或医学诊断。 6. 要保守:在有疑问时,不要包括这一特征。 - 定义:一个“特征”可能包括以下之一: - 行为模式(常态,常规) - 稳定的兴趣 - 个性倾向(如果明确支持的话) - 反复出现的情感倾向 - 明确的价值或信念 - - OutPUT FORMAT(STRIT): 仅返回一个 JSON 对象 : {"特征": [{"特征":"第一人称声明句"(例如:‘我倾向于熬夜并挣扎以早醒. ),"类别":"行为 QQ兴趣 QQ个性 QQ情感 QQ值","证据":["简短引文"],"自信":"高"}}或:{特征": []- 附加限制: - 每个特征必须写在First Person ("I...") - 每个特征必须是一个完整的声明句子 - 每个必须反映一个稳定的倾向,而不是一次性的事件 - 证据必须是直接引文(最多20个字) - 只能包含具有高度信心的特征 - 不要包括弱或模糊的特征 - 不要解释你的推理 - 不要概括博客 - DATA: <BLOG_HERE>

blocks.en: Question generation You are a data transformation assistant. Your task is to convert a first-person statement into a challenging multiple-choice question (4 options). Input: A single first-person sentence describing a personal preference, habit, or trait. Output format (STRICT JSON, no extra text): { "question": "<a natural question in first-person perspective>", "option1": "<option>", "option2": "<option>", "option3": "<option>", "option4": "<option>", "groundtruth": <1, 2, 3, or 4> } Requirements: [Core Question Design] 1. The question must be written in first-person (use "I") and end with a question mark. 2. The question must NOT directly reuse key nouns or verbs from the input. 3. The question should target a higher-level preference, tendency, or behavioral pattern - NOT a direct restatement of the activity. 4. The question should require at least one step of inference (i.e., not directly answerable by keyword matching). [Two Allowed Difficulty Styles - choose ONE per example] 5. Use ONE of the following strategies to increase difficulty: (A) Fine-grained distinction: - All four options belong to a similar broad domain but differ in subtle, meaningful ways. - Example dimensions: * types of activities (e.g., competitive sport vs leisure sport vs strategic game vs artistic hobby) * levels of accessibility (mass vs elite vs niche) * physical vs mental vs mixed engagement - Avoid overly similar options (e.g., basketball vs football). - Ensure distinctions are meaningful and inferable. (B) Abstract categorization: - Map the input to a higher-level personality trait, cognitive style, or behavioral tendency. - Example dimensions: * structured vs spontaneous vs exploratory vs habitual * social vs independent vs reflective vs expressive * analytical vs creative vs physical vs routine-oriented - Options should be conceptual and require interpretation of the input. [Option Quality] 6. Exactly FOUR options must be provided. 7. Only ONE option is correct. 8. All options must: - be concise (short phrases) - be at a similar level of abstraction - be semantically plausible (no obviously wrong answers) 9. Avoid negations (e.g., "not doing something"). 10. Ensure the incorrect options are strong distractors: - They should be reasonable interpretations but ultimately inconsistent with the input. [Balance & Structure] 11. Randomly assign the correct answer to option1-option4 (ensure distribution balance over multiple samples). 12. Maintain symmetry: - Similar length - Similar structure - Similar abstraction level [Reasoning Constraint] 13. Internally perform: - Step 1: Identify the core feature of the input (e.g., physical, intellectual, social, routine-based, exploratory, etc.) - Step 2: Map it to either a fine-grained category OR an abstract trait - Step 3: Generate 3 high-quality distractors from nearby but distinct categories 14. The final question must be solvable with reasonable inference, but not trivial. Output must be valid JSON (no comments, no trailing commas, no extra text). --- Example 1 (Fine-grained): Input: I like playing basketball. Output: { "question": "What kind of activity do I tend to prefer?", "option1": "casual leisure activities", "option2": "strategic board-based challenges", "option3": "physically competitive team sports", "option4": "solo creative expression", "groundtruth": 3 } --- Example 2 (Abstract): Input: I enjoy reading books. Output: { "question": "What kind of personal tendency best describes me?", "option1": "seeking intellectual engagement", "option2": "pursuing high-energy stimulation", "option3": "favoring spontaneous exploration", "option4": "preferring social interaction", "groundtruth": 1 } --- Input: <input_text>
blocks.zh: 提问生成 你是数据转换助理 您的任务是将第一人称语句转换为具有挑战性的多选择问题(4个选项). 输入:单人第一人称句,描述个人偏好,习惯,或特征. 输出格式(STRICT JSON,无额外文本):{ "问题":"第一人称视角中的自然问题","选项1":"选择","选项2":"选择","选项3":"选择","选项4","基础真相":<1,2,3或4>} 所需经费: [核心问题设计]. 1. 问题必须用第一人称书写(使用"I"),最后用问号结尾. 2. 问题不得直接重复使用输入中的关键名词或动词。 3. 问题应针对更高级别的偏好、倾向或行为模式,而不是直接重述活动。 4. 这个问题至少需要一步推论(即不直接用关键词匹配来回答)。 [两个允许的难度样式 - 每个示例选择一个] 5. 采用下列战略之一来增加难度:(A) 精细的区分: - 所有四个选项都属于一个类似的广泛领域,但在微妙和有意义的方面有所不同。 - 实例层面:*活动类型(例如,竞技体育与休闲体育与战略游戏与艺术爱好) *无障碍程度(大众与精英与优势) *身体与精神互动-避免过于相似的选择(例如,篮球与足球). - 确保区分是有意义的和不可推卸的。 (B) 抽象分类: - 将输入到更高层次的个性特征,认知风格,或行为倾向. - 示例维度: *结构化 vs自发性 vs 探索性 vs 习惯性 * 社会性 vs 独立性 vs 反射性 vs 表达性 * 分析性 vs 创造性 vs 物理性 vs 常规性 - 选项应该是概念性的,需要解释输入. [备选质量] 6. 必须提供4种选择。 7. 只有一种选择是正确的。 8. 所有备选方案都必须: 简洁(短语) ----抽象程度类似---- 明确合理(没有明显错误的答案) 9. 避免否定(如"不做某事"). 10. 确保不正确的选择是强大的转移注意力因素:这些选择应当是合理的解释,但最终与投入不一致。 [基准和结构] 11. 随机分配选项1-选项4(确保多个样本的分布平衡)的正确答案。 12. 保持对称性: - 相似长度 - 相似结构 - 相似抽象级 [重振约束] 13. 内部执行: - 第1步:确定投入的核心特征(例如,物理、智力、社会、常规、探索等) 第2步:将它映射成一个精细的类别或抽象的特征 - 第3步:产生3个来自附近但截然不同的类别14的高质量分光器. 最后的问题必须经过合理的推论才能解决,但并非微不足道。 输出必须是有效的JSON(没有注释,没有后面的逗号,没有额外的文本). --——例1(精细): 输入:我喜欢打篮球。 输出 : {“ 问题” : "我倾向于喜欢什么样的活动?","选项1":"偶然休闲活动","选项2":"基于战略板的挑战","选项3":"体育竞技团队运动","选项4":"索罗创意表达","地面真相": 3 } -- -- 例2(缩写): 输入:我喜欢看书。 输出 : {“ 问题” : " 什么样的个人倾向最能描述我?","选择1":"寻求智力参与","选择2":"追求高能量刺激","选择3":"喜欢自发探索","选择4":"优先社交互动","基础真相": 1} -- -- 输入: < input_text>

blocks.en: B.3 Population synthesis
blocks.zh: B.3 人口综合

blocks.en: We synthesize respondent-level populations for the 63 training studies in Cui et al. [2025] , for which the human findings are available as aggregate statistics without the underlying individual responses. Archived LLM respondents from Cui et al. [2025] provide an initial pool of complete answer patterns. We reconstruct populations from this pool in three coarse-to-fine steps:
blocks.zh: 我们为Cui等人的63项培训研究综合了答卷人数。 [2025],其中人类调查结果作为汇总统计数据提供,没有相应的个别答复. 来自Cui等人的LLM受访者存档 [2025] 提供了初步的完整答案模式集合. 我们从这个水池里重建人口 分三步走:

blocks.en: (1) Within-support reweighting: We optimize candidate sampling weights via gradient-based optimization against the published human statistics and convert them into integer respondent counts while preserving each condition’s original sample size. This step matches the target statistics as closely as possible without altering any individual item responses.
blocks.zh: (1) 在支助范围内重新加权: 我们通过基于梯度的优化来优化所公布的人类统计数据,优化候选抽样权重,并将其转换成整数,同时保留每个条件的原始样本大小。 这一步骤与目标统计数字尽可能吻合,而不改变任何个别项目的答复。

blocks.en: (2) Minimum-edit score projection: Mode collapse in the source LLM pool often leaves tail or extreme responses unrepresented, preventing reweighting alone from reaching the reported human variance. We therefore use mixed-integer programming to determine how many respondents receive each attainable scale score to match the condition mean and standard deviation. For each respondent, we then project their answers onto the closest valid item-response vector (via exact subset-sum dynamic programming) that achieves the assigned score with the fewest edits to the source answers.
blocks.zh: (2) 最低编辑分数预测: 源 LLM 池中的模式崩溃往往使尾部或极端反应无代表,使得单独重压无法达到报告的人类差异. 因此,我们使用混合整数编程来确定有多少答卷人得到每个可实现的比额表分数,以与条件平均值和标准差相匹配。 对于每个应答者,我们然后把他们的答案投射到最接近有效的项目响应向量上(通过精确的子集和动态编程),通过最少数编辑到源答案来实现指定分数.

blocks.en: (3) Joint cross-condition refinement: Finally, local search refines the population directly under the original study’s statistical analysis procedure, evaluating paired experimental conditions jointly so that between-condition treatment effects ( d d ) and significance outcomes are accurately recovered while preferring solutions with fewer source edits.
blocks.zh: (3) 共同改进交叉条件: 最后,地方搜索直接在原研究的统计分析程序下完善人口,共同评价对等实验条件,以便准确恢复条件间处理效果(dd)和意义结果,同时选择较少源编辑的解决方案.

blocks.en: We construct the literature reference benchmark from a large corpus of published psychometric research articles. Specially tailored LLM agents first parse these articles to identify psychological construct entities and their reported empirical relationships, followed by manual review to verify the extracted records. From this collection, we select entries that report Pearson correlation coefficients and map their construct entities onto Chiron’s 109-construct inventory. Construct alignment relies on scale names and common aliases, consulting construct definitions, item wording, and surrounding article context whenever the correspondence is ambiguous. Across the full inventory, this mapping yields 346 construct pairs spanning 92 constructs. For each pair, we aggregate multiple literature findings by taking the median reported correlation coefficient, and retain pairs supported by at least two empirical entries. This filtering produces the final benchmark of 150 reference relationships across 60 constructs, which is evaluated across all three datasets.
blocks.zh: 我们从大量发表的精神测量研究文章中构建文献参考基准。 专门定制的LLM代理人首先分析这些条款,以确定心理构造实体及其所报告的经验关系,然后进行人工审查,以核实提取的记录。 我们从中选择了报告皮尔逊相关系数的条目,并将它们的构造实体映射到Chiron的109个构造清单中。 建构对齐依赖于标尺名称和通用别名,咨询构造定义,项目措辞,以及当函证模棱两可时周围的文章上下文. 在整个库存中,这次测绘共产生346对建筑,跨越92个建筑。 对于每对,我们通过取中位报告的相关系数来汇总多个文献发现,并保留至少两个经验条目支持的对数. 这种过滤产生了60个构件的150个参考关系的最后基准,对所有三个数据集进行评价。

blocks.en: We evaluate these 150 relationships on three datasets with distinct record formats: PAN15 [ Rangel et al., 2015 ] (577 author-profiling participants), Essays [ Pennebaker and King, 1999 ] (2,467 personal essay authors), and ESS09 [ European Social Survey, 2018 ] (4,921 survey respondents). Within each dataset, Chiron infers all 109 construct scores for each individual, and we compute the Pearson correlation across individuals for each of the 150 construct pairs. We then compare this 150-element correlation vector against the literature reference vector using Pearson correlation, sign agreement, and MAE ( Table 8 ).
blocks.zh: 我们用三种不同的记录格式评价这150个关系:PAN15[Rangel等人,2015年](577名作者-描绘参与者)、Essays[Pennebaker and King,1999年](2 467名个人作文作者)和ESS09[欧洲社会调查,2018年](4 921名调查答复者)。 在每个数据集中,奇伦推断出每个个体的所有109个构造分数,我们计算出150个构造对中每个个体的皮尔逊相关性. 然后,我们用皮尔逊关联、签署协议和MAE(表8)与文献参考向量比较这一150元素相关矢量。

blocks.en: To test whether models compress inferred scores into a narrower range than human self-reports, we compare the dispersion of model predictions against self-reported Big Five personality percentiles on PANDORA [ Gjurković et al., 2021 ] . For each trait, we restrict the analysis to targets with valid scores from all five models, yielding 677 targets for agreeableness, 677 for conscientiousness, 676 for extraversion, 678 for neuroticism, and 677 for openness. Self-report percentiles are linearly mapped to [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] as described in § C.1.2 , whereas model scores are evaluated directly without fitting, rescaling, or clamping (retaining one out-of-range Chiron score on neuroticism). For each model m m and trait t t , we measure relative dispersion via the standard deviation ratio R m , t = SD ⁡ ( y ^ m , t ) / SD ⁡ ( y t ) R_{m,t}=\operatorname{SD}(\hat{y}_{m,t})/\operatorname{SD}(y_{t}) , where y ^ m , t \hat{y}_{m,t} and y t y_{t} denote the model scores and self-reports across the matched targets, and average R m , t R_{m,t} with equal weight across the five traits. A ratio of 1 1 indicates matching dispersion, values below 1 1 indicate score compression, and values above 1 1 indicate score expansion. Because R m , t R_{m,t} compares marginal spread across individuals, it is invariant to mean shifts and distinct from individual-level accuracy. Trait-level descriptive statistics and SD ratios are reported in Table 9 .

blocks.en: To test whether construct scores remain invariant to construct-irrelevant context, we construct six-statement inputs that combine three target items measuring a given construct with three filler items drawn from other constructs. The filler items are assigned midpoint responses on their native scales (corresponding to a normalized score of zero), and all item–response pairs are rendered as natural-language statements using fixed templates (for example, “It is neither accurate nor inaccurate to say that I keep my cool”). We then replace the three fillers with a different set of midpoint filler statements while keeping the target statements and their positions unchanged. Across 543 evaluation units spanning the 109 constructs (up to five units per construct), we score the original and modified inputs independently, compute the mean absolute score change within each construct, and average across constructs.
blocks.zh: 为了测试构造分数是否仍然与构造无关,我们构建了六份报表,将测量某一构造的三个目标项目与从其他构造中提取的三个填充项目结合起来。 填充器被按其原生比例(相当于正常的零分数)分配中点响应,所有项目 - 响应对是用固定模板作为自然语句(例如,“我保持冷静既不准确也不不准确”). 然后,我们用一套不同的中点填充语句取代三个填充语句,同时保持目标语句及其位置不变。 跨越109个构件的543个评价单位(每个构件最多5个单位),我们独立地对原始和修改后的投入进行评分,计算每个构件中的平均绝对分数变化,以及各个构件的平均值。

blocks.en: Using the same six-statement input structure (three target items and three midpoint fillers), we test whether scores depend on record ordering under two conditions: one with all three target responses indicating a low construct level, and another with all three indicating a high level, both accompanied by the same fillers. For each of the 540 units, we reverse the order of the six statements in both the low- and high-evidence conditions, calculate the absolute score change caused by reversal in each condition, and take the mean of the two changes. As above, results are summarized within constructs and then averaged across constructs.
blocks.zh: 使用相同的六表输入结构(三个目标项目和三个中点填充器),我们测试分数是否取决于在两个条件下的记录顺序:一个是所有三个目标响应都表示低构造水平,另一个是所有三个都表示高水平,两个条件都有相同的填充器. 对于540个单元中的每一单元,我们都会在低证据和高证据条件中颠倒六个语句的顺序,计算每个条件的倒转引起的绝对分数变化,并取两个变化的平均值. 如上所述,结果在结构内汇总,然后在结构内平均。

blocks.en: C.1.5 Experimental manipulation
blocks.zh: C.1.5 试验性操纵

blocks.en: All three intervention settings follow the same experimental manipulation logic: we hold a background context fixed and systematically manipulate construct-relevant evidence by replacing low-level evidence for a target construct with high-level evidence, testing whether the inferred construct score increases accordingly.
blocks.zh: 所有三种干预设置都遵循同样的实验操纵逻辑:我们持有一个固定的背景,并系统地操纵构造相关证据,用高水平证据取代目标构造的低水平证据,测试推断的构造分数是否相应增加.

blocks.en: For each of the 109 constructs, we construct four-level input series (six statements per input) by pairing three target statements with three fixed neutral background statements. Starting from Level 1 (all three target statements at the low level), we successively replace one, two and all three low-level target statements with their high-level counterparts (Levels 2–4), keeping the background statements and positions unchanged: • Questionnaire evidence ( n = 541 n=541 series; up to five per construct): each target statement is a naturalized questionnaire item whose response is flipped from its low to its high endpoint (for example, changing “I know how to captivate people” from “Very inaccurate” to “Very accurate”), producing four levels with mean target scores of − 1 -1 , − 1 / 3 -1/3 , 1 / 3 1/3 and 1 1 . The three background statements are midpoint filler items from other constructs ( § C.1.4 ). • Narrative evidence ( n = 325 n=325 series; up to three per construct): each low–high pair consists of two held-out synthetic narratives ( § 3.3.1 ) with negative and positive Bradley–Terry scores, matched in scenario, writing style, length and absolute intensity (for example, preferring a quiet evening alone versus seeking out a friend’s company for extraversion). The three background statements describe routine daily activities and are shared across constructs.
blocks.zh: 对于109个构件中的每一个,我们通过将3个目标语句与3个固定中性背景语句配对来构建4级输入序列(每输入6个语句). 从第一级(所有三个低级目标声明)开始,我们相继将一个、两个和所有三个低级目标声明替换为高级别对应方(第2至第4级),使背景声明和立场保持不变: 调查表证据(n = 541 n = 541系列;每个构件最多5个):每个目标声明是一个归化的调查表项目,其答复从低点翻转至高端(例如,将 " 我知道如何吸引人 " 从 " 非常不准确 " 改为 " 非常准确 " ),产生了四个级别,平均目标分数为-1-1-1/1/3、1-3/1/3和1-1)。 三种背景说明是来自其他构造的中点填充项目(§C.1.4)。 · 叙述性证据(n = 325 n = 325系列;每个构件最多3个):每对低高的一对由两个搁置的合成叙事(§ 3.3.1)组成,有负和正的布拉德利-特里分数,与情景,写作风格,长度和绝对强度相匹配(例如,宁可单独静静的夜晚,而不要寻找朋友的公司进行外推). 三个背景说明介绍日常活动,并相互交流。

blocks.en: Questionnaire evidence ( n = 541 n=541 series; up to five per construct): each target statement is a naturalized questionnaire item whose response is flipped from its low to its high endpoint (for example, changing “I know how to captivate people” from “Very inaccurate” to “Very accurate”), producing four levels with mean target scores of − 1 -1 , − 1 / 3 -1/3 , 1 / 3 1/3 and 1 1 . The three background statements are midpoint filler items from other constructs ( § C.1.4 ).

The three background statements describe routine daily activities and are shared across constructs.
blocks.zh: 叙述性证据(n = 325 n = 325系列;每个构造最多3个):每对低-高的一对由两个搁置的合成叙事(§ 3.3.1)组成,有负和正的布拉德利-特里分数,与情景,写作风格,长度和绝对强度相匹配(例如,宁可单独静静的夜晚,而不要寻找朋友的公司进行外传). 三个背景说明介绍日常活动,并相互交流。

blocks.en: To test whether a single piece of contrasting evidence shifts scores in the expected direction against a realistic personal history, we sample 200 personal-record backgrounds each from PANDORA, DASS and IPIP-FFM ( n = 592 n=592 evaluated units). Each background is assigned a target construct and one held-out low–high narrative pair from above. We compare two versions of the input—one with the low-level narrative inserted and one with the high-level narrative inserted at the exact same position (placed before the original records in half of the units and after them in the other half).
blocks.zh: 为了检验单一的对比证据是否将分数按照预期方向与现实的个人历史相转移,我们抽取了来自PANDORA,DASS和IPIP-FFM(n=592n=592评价单位)的200个个人记录背景. 每个背景被分配到一个目标构件和上面一个悬浮的低高的叙述对。 我们比较了两个版本的输入——一个与插入的低级叙事,一个与插入的高度叙事,位置完全相同(在原始记录之前放在一半单位,在另一半单位之后)。

blocks.en: Every input version is scored independently. For the four-level questionnaire and narrative series, stepwise monotonicity is the proportion of the three adjacent steps ( Level ​ 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 \text{Level }1\to 2\to 3\to 4 ) in which the target score strictly increases, and direction accuracy is the proportion of series in which Level 4 scores higher than Level 1. For real personal records, direction accuracy is the proportion of units in which the input with the high-level narrative scores higher than the input with the low-level narrative. All metrics are computed within each construct and then averaged across constructs ( Table 11 ).
blocks.zh: 每个输入版本都独立得分. 对于四级问卷和叙事系列,顺位单调是目标分数严格递增的三个相邻步骤(第1级~第2级~第3级~第4个\text{Level}}的比例,方向精度是第4级分数高于第1级的系列比例. 对于真实的个人记录,方向精确度是指与高层次叙事分数的输入比与低层次叙事分数的输入高的单位比例. 所有衡量标准都在每个构造中计算,然后在构造中平均(表11)。

blocks.en: C.2 Individual behavioural prediction
blocks.zh: C.2 个人行为预测

blocks.en: C.2.1 Input formats and prompts
blocks.zh: 第C.2.1条 输入格式和提示

blocks.en: For behavioural prediction, Chiron uses the following shared system prompt:
blocks.zh: 对于行为预测,Chiron使用以下共享系统即时:

blocks.en: System prompt You are a psychometric measurement and prediction model. You will receive person-level records, such as statements, behaviors, events, or attributes. Use these records as evidence to answer the prediction questions about that person. Output only the final answer(s).
blocks.zh: 系统提示 你是一个心理测量和预测模型。 您将接收人级记录, 如声明、行为、事件或属性。 用这些记录作为证据来回答关于这个人的预测问题. 只输出最后的答案。

blocks.en: Each behavioural prediction example consists of a short description of the record context, the visible personal records enclosed in <person_records> … </person_records> , and one or more multiple-choice target questions:
blocks.zh: 每一个行为预测实例包括:记录上下文的简短描述,<人_记录>中所附可见的个人记录. </人_记录>,以及一个或多个多选择目标问题:

blocks.en: User prompt {record_context} <person_records> {observations} </person_records> Questions: {questions}
blocks.zh: 用户提示 {record_context} < person_records > {Observations} </person_records > 问题 : {问题}

blocks.en: The model reads the personal records and questions as a single input and outputs the predicted answer token(s) in order, without repeating the questions or generating explanations. During training, the cross-entropy loss is computed only on the reference answer tokens. The shortened fictional examples below illustrate the three types of prediction targets.
blocks.zh: 该模型将个人记录和问题读作单一输入,并按顺序输出预测的回答符号,而不重复提问或产生解释。 在培训期间,交叉性损失只根据参考答录符计算。 下文缩短的虚构例子说明了三类预测目标。

blocks.en: The target is one of the response options for a held-out questionnaire item, while the visible records contain other answers from the same person:
blocks.zh: 目标是一个被搁置的调查问卷项目的答复选项之一,而可见的记录包含来自同一人的其他答复:

blocks.en: <person_records> I prefer to spend free time with a small group of close friends. I usually plan tomorrow’s tasks before going to bed. </person_records> Question 1: How often does the person plan activities in advance? A. Never B. Sometimes C. Often Target output: C
blocks.zh: < 个人_ 记录> 我更喜欢和一群亲密的朋友闲暇 我通常会在睡觉前规划明天的任务。 </人_记录> 问题 1: 此人何时提前规划活动? 目标产出:C

blocks.en: For writing datasets with external categorical annotations, the question asks for the annotated category directly:
blocks.zh: 对于带有外部绝对说明的数据集,问题直接要求附加说明的类别:

blocks.en: <person_records> I keep a detailed schedule and check each task before moving on. When plans change, I reorganize the list and continue working. </person_records> Question 1: Select the conscientiousness category. Labels: low medium high Target output: high
blocks.zh: < 个人_ 记录> 我有一个详细的时间表 并检查每一个任务之前继续。 当计划改变,我重组名单,继续工作。 </人_记录> 问题 1:选择良心类别。 标签:低中高 目标产出:高

blocks.en: For classification tasks or masked observation prediction derived from personal writing, the withheld observation is presented as a multiple-choice question:
blocks.zh: 对于从个人写作中得出的分类任务或蒙面观察预测,被扣留的观察被作为一个多选择的问题提出:

blocks.en: <person_records> I usually turn down guided tours and figure out routes on my own. At work, I would rather test a new approach than follow a fixed template. </person_records> Question 1: What tends to guide the person’s choices when taking on a new project? A. Independent exploration B. External approval C. Routine stability D. Material reward Target output: A
blocks.zh: < 个人_ 记录> 我通常会拒绝导游 自己想办法找到路线 在工作上,我宁愿测试一种新的方法,也不愿遵循固定的模板。 </人_记录> 问题 1:在接受新项目时,什么是指导个人的选择? B. 外部核准 C. 常规稳定性 D. 物质奖励

blocks.en: When an input contains multiple questions, the model outputs one numbered answer per line in the order of the questions, allowing a single forward pass to combine heterogeneous question formats:
blocks.zh: 当一个输入包含多个问题时,模型输出一个按问题顺序逐行编号的答案,允许单个前传将不同的问题格式结合起来:

blocks.en: Question 1: What tends to guide the person’s choices when taking on a new project? A. Independent exploration B. External approval C. Routine stability D. Material reward Question 2: Select the conscientiousness category. Labels: low medium high Question 3: How often does the person plan activities in advance? A. Never B. Sometimes C. Often Target output: Q1: A Q2: high Q3: C
blocks.zh: 问题1:在接受新项目时,什么倾向于指导个人的选择? A. 独立勘探 B. 外部批准 C. 常规稳定性 D. 物质奖励 问题2:选择良心类别。 标签:低中高题3:人提前规划活动多久?. A. Never B. 有时C. 经常目标输出:Q1:A Q2:高Q3:C

blocks.en: C.2.2 Evaluation protocol and detailed results
blocks.zh: C.2.2 评价程序和详细结果

blocks.en: In the 29-domain prediction evaluation ( § 4.2 ), Chiron and the four baselines (GPT-6 Sol, Claude Opus 5.5, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B) receive the same personal records and target questions. All models are evaluated at temperature zero with reasoning disabled. Domain-level prediction accuracies and standard errors across all 29 domains are reported in Table 12 .
blocks.zh: 在29域预测评价(§4.2)中,Chiron和4个基线(GPT-6 Sol,Claude Opus 5.5,DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash和Qune3.6-35B-A3B)获得相同的个人记录和目标问题. 所有模型均在零温下评价,推理被禁用. 表12报告了所有29个领域的域级预测速率和标准差错。

blocks.en: Table 12 : Domain-level behavioural prediction results across all 29 domains. Domain entries report mean prediction accuracy ± 1 \pm 1 SEM. For GPT-6 Sol, 60 refused requests after retries are excluded when computing its mean accuracy; malformed outputs (two Blog cases for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B) are scored as zero.
blocks.zh: 表12:所有29个领域的域级行为预测结果。 域条目报告指预测精度±1\pm 1 SEM. 对于GPT-6 Sol,在计算其平均精度时排除了60个复试后被拒绝的请求;错误的输出(Qune3.6-35B-A3B的两个博客案例)被评为零.

blocks.en: C.2.3 Detailed experimental setup for linking construct measurement to prediction
blocks.zh: C.2.3 将构造测量与预测联系起来的详细实验设置

blocks.en: We test whether Chiron’s construct measurements and predicted questionnaire responses change together when evidence about a hypothetical person is varied ( Fig. 5 e). The experiment covers all 109 constructs.
blocks.zh: 我们检验Chiron的构造测量和预测的问卷答复是否在假设人的证据不同时一起改变(图5e)。 实验涵盖所有109个构造.

blocks.en:
For each construct, we create records containing three fixed statements about everyday background and three responses to questionnaire items. The item responses describe different levels of the construct. For example, agreement with “I follow a schedule” provides evidence of higher conscientiousness. We make four versions of each record: at L1, all three responses indicate low construct levels; one response is switched to its high-level counterpart at each step, until all three indicate high levels at L4. For an item describing disorganized habits, disagreement supplies the high-conscientiousness response.
For each of the 109 constructs, we combine five sets of background notes with four levels of construct-relevant evidence, yielding 2,180 input records.
blocks.zh:
对于每个构件,我们创建记录,包含三个关于日常背景的固定声明和三个对问卷项目的答复。 本项目的答复描述了这一结构的不同程度。 例如,与“我按时间表行事”的协议就证明了更高的自觉性。 我们每个记录都有四个版本:在L1,所有三个答复都表明构造水平较低;每个步骤有一个答复被切换到高级别对应方,直到所有三个答复都表明L4的水平较高。 对于描述无组织习惯的项目,分歧提供了高度良知的反应.
对于109个构件中的每一个,我们把5套背景说明和4级与构件相关的证据结合起来,产生了2,180个输入记录.

blocks.en: Three other items about the same construct are reserved as prediction questions. They never appear in that construct’s input records and remain fixed across its backgrounds and evidence levels. The model predicts how the hypothetical person would answer each question, giving 6,540 item predictions. Of the 327 construct-specific target questions, 262 use existing questionnaire items, and the other 65 are written from construct definitions when existing items are not sufficient.
blocks.zh: 关于同一结构的其他三个项目被保留作为预测问题。 它们从未出现在该建筑的输入记录中,而且始终固定在其背景和证据水平上。 该模型预测假设的人如何回答每个问题,给出了6,540项的预测. 在327个针对特定结构的目标问题中,262个使用了现有的调查表项目,其他65个是在现有项目不足时根据建筑定义编写的。

blocks.en: During evaluation, the model returns a construct score using only the personal records. Each prediction question is then presented separately. We score its possible Option N answers and normalize their probabilities over the listed options. The expected response is the probability-weighted mean of the option numbers. We linearly rescale this expectation to [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] , reversing items for which larger responses indicate less of the construct. Higher prediction scores therefore always indicate more of the target construct. We average the three transformed expectations to obtain one prediction score for the record. A transition between adjacent evidence levels counts as jointly consistent only when both the measured construct score and the prediction score strictly increase. We average these results over the 15 transitions per construct (five backgrounds, three transitions each), then equally across constructs.
blocks.zh: 在评价期间,模型只使用个人记录返回一个构造分数. 然后将每个预测问题单独提出。 我们对其可能的选项N答案进行评分,使其对所列选项的概率正常化。 预期的反应是选项号的概率加权平均值. 我们将这一预期线性调整为[− 1, 1] [-1, 1],扭转那些较大的答复表明结构较少的项目。 因此,较高的预测分数总是显示更多的目标结构。 我们平均三个转变的预期值,以获得记录的一个预测分数。 只有在测量的构造分数和预测分数严格增加时,相邻证据水平之间的过渡才算为共同一致。 我们平均在每次结构的15次过渡(5次背景,每次3次过渡)中得出这些结果,然后在结构之间取得同样的结果。

blocks.en: C.3 Population simulation
blocks.zh: C.3 人口模拟

blocks.en: C.3.1 Evaluation protocol and prompts
blocks.zh: C.3.1 评价协议和提示

blocks.en: We evaluate population simulation on 15 held-out studies comprising 45 experimental conditions and 4,277 planned virtual respondents per model ( Table 3 ). For each condition, Chiron uses the shared system prompt in § C.2.1 and receives the experimental scenario and study items formatted as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们评价15项搁置研究的人口模拟,包括45个实验条件和4 277个计划每个模型的虚拟答复者(表3)。 对于每个条件,Chiron使用§C.2.1中的共享系统提示,并接收实验情景,研究项目格式如下:

blocks.en: User prompt Below are records describing one participant in an experimental scenario. <person_records> {experimental scenario and condition text} </person_records> Questions: Q1. {study-specific question content} Please predict this participant’s response to the following item: {study-specific item content} Option 1: {option text} Option 2: {option text} ... Q2. {study-specific question content} Please predict this participant’s response to the following item: {study-specific item content} Option 1: {option text} Option 2: {option text} ...
blocks.zh: 用户提示 以下是描述实验情景中一位参与者的记录。 < person_records > {experiental situres and context} </person_records> 问题:问题1. {研究特定问题内容> 请预测这位与会者对以下项目的反应:{研究特定项目内容} 备选案文1:{可选案文} 备选案文2:{可选案文} . . . .  .... 问题2. {研究特定问题内容} 请预测这位与会者对以下项目的反应:{研究特定项目内容} 备选案文1:{可选案文} 备选案文2:{可选案文}...

blocks.en: Assistant target format Q1: Option {option_id} Q2: Option {option_id} ...
blocks.zh: 助理目标格式 问题1: 选项{选项_id} 问题2: 选项{选项_id} . . . .  ....

blocks.en: For each condition, we sample as many independent completions from Chiron as the human condition sample size using temperature one and top- p p one. Baseline models (GPT-6 Sol, Claude Opus 5.5, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B) follow the scenario-based replication protocol of Cui et al. [2025] .
blocks.zh: 对于每个条件, 我们用温度1和最高的P 1 来取样来自Chiron的独立完成 和人类条件样本大小。 基线模型(GPT-6 Sol, Claude Opus 5.5, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash和Qune3.6-35B-A3B)遵循Cui等人基于情景的复制协议[2025].

blocks.en: C.3.2 Detailed results
blocks.zh: C.3.2 详细结果

blocks.en: Following Cui et al. [2025] , we apply each study’s original scoring procedure and summarize agreement between simulated and human outcomes across five metrics: Cohen’s d d MAE and Pearson correlation (comparing human and simulated standardized effect sizes), effect direction accuracy (whether simulated and human effects share the same sign), statistical significance F1 (treating human p < 0.05 p<0.05 significance decisions as reference labels), and response-distribution NMAE (measuring normalized errors in condition means and standard deviations).
blocks.zh: 按照Cui等人[2025年],我们采用每项研究的原始评分程序,并总结模拟结果与人类结果之间五个衡量标准的一致性: Cohen的 d d MAE 和 Pearson 相关性(比较人类和模拟标准化效应大小)、效果方向精度(模拟和人类效应是否具有相同的标志)、统计意义F1(将人类p < 0.05 p < 0.05 意义决定作为参考标签)和反应-分布NMAE(衡量条件手段和标准偏差的正常错误)。

blocks.en: Because not every study reports all statistics, the 15-study evaluation comprises 25 eligible effect-size pairs (from eight studies), 42 direction comparisons, 53 significance comparisons, and 34 distribution comparisons. Aggregate results across all five models are reported in Table 13 .
blocks.zh: 因为并不是每个研究都报告所有统计数据,15项研究评价包括25个符合条件的效应大小对(来自8项研究)、42个方向比较、53个意义比较和34个分布比较。 所有五个模型的汇总结果见表13。

blocks.en: Table 13 : Aggregate experimental results of population simulation.
blocks.zh: 表13:人口模拟综合实验结果.
